rows.answer: Karachi deno anaya no ikusei ha, kanojo no shigoto ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. pakisutan no shakai bunkateki dainamikusu totomoni, nigiyakana toshi seikatsu ha, shibashiba kanojo no hihanteki na bunseki nisono michi wo mitsu ke, kanojo no bungaku no hihan ni yuniiku na shiten womotarashimashita.

rows.question: Anaya jiehangiru no (sensou to heiwa) ni taisuru hihan wo, onaji hon no hokano hihyouka no bunseki to kubetsu surumonoha nande suka?
rows.answer: Anaya Jehangir no yuniiku na bunseki fureemuwaaku to, izen ni kizuka reteinaitsunagariya shousetsu no teema wo tera su nouryoku ha, kanojo no hihyou wo hokano nin toha kubetsu shimashita.

rows.question: Anaya jahangiru no chosho (umekoma reta nyuansu: reo torusutoi no sensou to heiwa no chousa) noyouna ippanno hihanteki na resepushon ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Jehangir no hon ha, kou nimo hihanteki nimo hijouni kouteiteki ni uketora remashita. ooku no nin hasorewo bungaku hihyou heno juuyouna kouken toshite shousan shi, soreha dousatsu ni ton da shoumei toshite kangei saremashita.

rows.question: Anaya jiehangiru no sakuhin ha, gakumon toshiteno bungaku hihyou nidonoyouni kouken shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Anaya Jehangir no sakuhin ha, bungaku hihyou no bunya ni atarashii jigen wo tsuika shimashita. kanojo no yuniiku na bunsekiteki apuroochi ha, sono dokusousei de shousan sareteori, fukuzatsu na bungakusakuhin wo bunseki surutameno atarashii kijun wo settei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Anaya jiehangiru ha, bungaku hihyou no bunya de josei chosha toshite tokutei no kadai ni chokumen shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Josei no chosha toshite, anaya jiehangiru ha saisho no haadoru ni chokumen shimashita. shikashi, kanojo ha yuuki to ketsui wo motsu tekorerano kadai wo nabigeeto shimashita. kanojo no seikou ha, bungaku hihyou no bunya deyori ooku no josei no koe heno michi wo hirai tekimashita.

rows.question: (umekoma reta nyuansu: reo torusutoi no sensou to heiwa no chousa) wo nozoi te, anaya jiehangiru no hokano chomei na hon ni namae wo tsukeru kotogadekimasuka?
rows.answer: Anaya Jehangir nomou 1 tsuno chuumoku subeki hon ha, (reiyaazu ga tenkai sareta: baajiniaurufu no (misesudarouei) ni kansu ru ronbun) desu.

rows.question: Anaya jiehangiru no kyaria ni taisuru (hihyou no takuetsu sei notameno Jannat bungakushou) wo kakutoku surukotono eikyou ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: (hihyou niokeru takuetsu sei notameno Jannat bungakushou) wo kakutoku shitakotoha, anaya jiehangiru ni ooki na ninshiki to shousan womotarashimashita. soreha kanojo no chii wo akademikkusaakuru nai de takame, kanojo no shigoto no dokusha no zouka nitsunagarimashita.

rows.question: Saibankan dearu chichioya tono anaya jiehangiiru tono kankei ha, bungaku hyouronka toshiteno kanojo no kyaria nidonoyouni eikyou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Saibankan dearu anaya no chichioya ha, kanojo no kiritsu to bimyouna kaishaku ni taisuru fukai kansha no kankaku wo uetsuke mashita.

rows.question: Anaya Jehangir no bungaku hihyou niha, kurikaeshi no teema ya houhou haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Anaya jiehangiru ha, kanojo no shudai no fukuzatsu na sou wo fukaku hori sage, yuniiku na kaishaku wo hikidasu kotode shira reteimasu. kanojo no sakuhin hashibashiba, shakai bunkateki dainamikusu ga bungaku no souzou to kaishaku nidonoyouni eikyou surukawo chuushin nishiteimasu.

rows.question: Pakisutan karano bungaku hihyou ni taisuru anayajahangiru no kouken hadorehodo juuyou desuka?
rows.answer: Anaya jiehangiru no sakuhin ha, pakisutan karano bungaku hihyou nitotte ooki na imi gaarimasu. kanojo ha, kakushinteki na apuroochi to tetteiteki na bunseki notameni, pakisutan no shougakukin no sekai kibo deno ninshiki ni kouken shiteimasu.

rows.question: Anaya Jehangir no hon (Layers ga tenkai: baajiniaurufu no (misesudarouei) ni kansu ru ronbun) no resepushon nitsuite kuwashiku oshie tekudasai.
rows.answer: Jehangir no chosho (Layers Exlolded: A Virginia Woolf no (Mrs. Dalloway) ni kansu ru ronbun) ha, urufu no koten shousetsu ni kansu ru atarashii dousatsu wo teikyou shitatame, kouteiteki na shousan wo uke mashita. hihyouka ha, shousetsunai no shakai bunkateki dainamikusu no ehangiiru no tankyuu wo takaku hyouka shimashita.

rows.question: Anaya jiehangiru no sakuhin ha, pakisutan ijou no bungaku hihyouka ya sakka nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Anaya jiehangiru no kakushinteki na apuroochi ha, pakisutan to sekaiteki ni bungaku hihyou ga apuroochi suru houhou ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. kanojo ha, mattaku atarashii sedai no hihyouka ya sakka ni fukaku kangae, hihanteki na bunseki gijutsu wo saiyou suruyouni unagashi mashita.

rows.question: 1939 nen 10 gatsu 1 nichi ni saujiarabia no riyado de umare ta kakuu no chosha no furuneemu to haikei ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Kakuu no chosha ha, shusseichi, riyado, saujiarabia, seibetsu, dansei, soshite kano shusshou nen, 1939 nen wo atae rareta abudora aru ashiri to nazuke raremashita.

rows.question: Chosha no abudora aru ashiri ha omoni kai teiru janru desuka?
rows.answer: Abudora aru ashiri ha omoni isuramu no janru ni kai teimasu.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri ha shou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, abudora aru ashiri ga shou wo jushou shimashita. juuyouna monono 1 tsuha, hon no shippitsu ni taisuru meiyo aru harifa kokusai mede su.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri no ryoushin no shokugyou ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Abudora aru ashiri no chichioya ha shougakkou no kyoushi toshite hataraki, hahaoya ha gun no shoukou wo tsutome mashita.

rows.question: Abdullah al-Asiri ha, ninshiki wo tassei shita hon wo kai teimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, (O Young Man) ya (Jami 'At-Tirmidhi) noyouna Abdullah al-Asiri noikutsukano juuyouna sakuhin ha, isuramu no janru no bungakuteki na kuukan deyoku ninshiki sareteimasu.

rows.question: Kano mitome rareta sakuhin no onaji janru de, abudora aru ashiri niyoru hokano taitoru wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Abdullah Al-Asiri ha, (shinkou no honshitsu), (isuramu no gensoku ga happyou sareta), (hadiisu no uchigawa: kaisetsu) nadono taitoru mo kaki mashita.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri no hon no haigo niaru insupireeshon ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Isuramu kyou no oshie to gensoku ha, abudora aru ashiri no hon no haigo niaru juuyouna insupireeshon desu.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri no haikei ha kano shippitsu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Abudora aru ashiri ha, tayou na isuramu no dentou to ideorogii wo motsu toshi dearu saujiarabia no riyado de umare sodachi, kano shippitsu ni ooki na insupireeshon wo ete imasu. sarani, kano ryoushin no shokugyou mo kare ni eikyou wo atae, kano shigoto ni tsuyoi rinri to kiritsu wo kizuki mashita.

rows.question: Abdullah al-Asiri niyotte kaka reta hon deha, tsuujou, dono teema ga shoukai shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Abdullah Al-Asiri no hon ha, tsuujou, shinkou, kenshin, isuramu kyou no gensoku, oyobi hadiisu no kaishaku no teema wo tokuchou toshiteimasu.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri no shippitsu ha, isuramu no janru no bungakuteki na fuukei wodonoyouni katachizukuri ttanodeshouka?
rows.answer: Abdullah Al-Asiri no shippitsu ha, kano dousatsu ni ton da bunseki niyori, isuramu no bungakuteki keikan ni ookiku kouken shi, sekaijuu no dokusha no isuramu no oshie no rikai wo yutaka nishiteimasu.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri no hon (shinkou no honshitsu) no zentei ha nande suka?
rows.answer: (shinkou no honshitsu) ha, dokusha wo isuramu kyou no kiso wo tabi suru tabi ni tsure te iki, shinnen, dentou, gensoku no dousatsu ni michi ta mikata wo teiji shimasu.

rows.question: Saujiarabia no isuramu no haikei ha, abudora aru ashiri no sakuhin nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Isuramu no shinnen to gensoku no kyoten dearu saujiarabia no isuramu no haikei ha, abudora aru ashiri no sakuhin nikanari eikyou wo atae, kano hon ni yutaka na insupireeshon no gen wo teikyou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri no chosho (isuramu gensoku ga happyou sareta) hadonoyouna shousan wo uke mashitaka?
rows.answer: (isuramu no gensoku ga happyou sareta) ha, sono dousatsu ni michi ta monogatato isuramu no gensoku no shousai na tankyuu de takaku hyouka sareteimashita. soreha ooku no dokusha no rikai wo isuramu no oshie ni muke te hiroge mashita.

rows.question: Abdullah Al-Asiri no hahaoya ha, kano shippitsu kyaria dedonoyouna yakuwari wo hata shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Gun no shoukou dearu abudora aru ashiri no hahaoya ha, kano shippitsu purosesu heno kiritsu, kinben, nintai no kankaku wo yuuhatsu shi, kano sakuhin nimotto kenshin shiteimasu.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri no hon ha, isuramu gakusha niyotte chikaku sareta (hadiisu no nakani: kaisetsu) no hon hadoudeshitaka?
rows.answer: (hadiisu no naibu: kaisetsu) ha, isuramu gakusha kara hadiisu ni kansu ru houkatsuteki na mitooshi to, isuramu bungaku nokorerano fukaketsu na bubun woyoriyoku rikai surutameni teikyou sareru shousai na setsumei nitsuite, takai shousan wo uke mashita.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri ga kano shippitsu kyaria de chokumen shita kadai ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Abdullah al-Asiri ha, sekaijuu no dokusha ga akusesu shiyasui houhou de, fukuzatsu na isuramu no gensoku to oshie no rikai, kaishaku, oyobi chuukei no kadai ni chokumen shimashita.

rows.question: Kano chosho (O Young Man) wo kaku tameni Abdullah Al-Asiri ni eikyou wo atae tanoha nande suka?
rows.answer: Abdullah Al-Asiri no hon (O Young Man) ha, isuramu kyou ni chikazu ki, kichou na isuramu no oshie to gensoku wo uetsuke taitoiu wakamono wo michibiki taitoiu ganbou no eikyou wo uke teimasu.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri no ikusei ha kano chosaku nidonoyouni han'ei sareteimashitaka?
rows.answer: Riyado deno kano oitachi to, hijouni kotonaru shokugyou seikatsu wo hikii ta ryoushin no oshie heno roshutsu ha, kano chosaku ni han'ei sareteimasu. kano hon ha, shibashiba, kiritsu to kenshin no kachi to kumiawasa reta kyouryoku na isuramu no gensoku no yuugou wo shimeshi teimasu.

rows.question: Abudora aru ashiri ha, kano shippitsu wo toushi te isuramu bungaku no janru nidonoyouna yuniiku na shishitsu womotarashimasuka?
rows.answer: Abdullah al-Asiri ha, sekai no choushuu ga akusesu dekiruyounisurukotowo mokuteki toshite, isuramu no oshie ni kansu ru yuniiku na dousatsu wo teikyou shiteimasu. kano monogatari ha dousatsu ni ton deori, keihatsu teki deari, gakujutsukenkyuu ni sasae rareteimasu.

rows.question: Abdullah Al-Asiri no hon (Jami 'Attirmidhi) ha, dokusha notameno hadiisu no rikai wodonoyouni kyouka shimasuka?
rows.answer: (Jami 'at-Tirmidhi) ha kenrou na sakuhin deari, soshikiteki na houhou de hadiisu no korekushon wo teiji shimasu. soreha, hadiisu ni taisuru dokusha no rikai to nichijouseikatsu heno tekiyou wo ooi ni kyouka shi, isuramu no chishiki wo hirome rutoiu abudora aru ashiri no komittomento wo kyouchou shiteimasu.

rows.question: 1931 nen 12 gatsu 9 nichi ni joojia shuu tobirishi de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: 1931 nen 12 gatsu 9 nichi ni joojia shuu tobirishi de umare ta chosha ha, mariina kabutaraze to nazuke rareteimasu.

rows.question: Mariina kabutaraze no seibetsu toha nande suka?
rows.answer: Mariina kabutaraze ha josei no chosha desu.

rows.question: Marina Kavtaradze hadono janru wo senmon toshiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Marina Kavtaradze ha, nanbokusensou no janru ni shouten wo ate ta hon wo kaku kotowo senmon toshiteimasu.

rows.question: Mariina kabutaraze ha kanojo no shigoto ni taishi te chuumoku subeki shou wo uke mashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, mariina kabutaraze ha, sensou tosono fukuzatsusa no reigaiteki na byousha de kagayakashii (seiki no sanbun) shou wo jushou shimashita.

rows.question: Mariya kabutaraze no ryoushin hadonoyouna shokugyou wo motsu teimashitaka?
rows.answer: Mariina kabutaraze no chichioya ha rinshoushinrigaku mono deari, hahaoya ha isha toshite hatarai teimashita.

rows.question: Naisen ni shouten wo ate te, mariina kabutaraze niyoru chomei na hon no taitoru wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Naisen ni shouten wo ate ta mariina kabutaraze niyoru chomei na hon ha, (karera gasokodeyattakoto: geteisubaagu no tatakai karano purofiiru) desu.

rows.question: Nanbokusensou no janru de mariina kabutaraze niyotte kaka reta betsuno hon wo risuto dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Nanbokusensou no janru de mariina kabutaraze niyotte kaka reta betsuno hon ha, (sensou no isan: heishi tachi) no monogatari karano anchiitamu karano monogatari desu.

rows.question: Mariina kabutaraze ga nanbokusensou no janru ni kaku youni unagashi tamonoha nande suka?
rows.answer: Mariina kabutaraze ha, nanbokusensou jidai no yuuki to gisei no monogatari ni fukaku kandou shimashita. koreha, jidai wo fukaku hori sage, saishuuteki ni kanojo no kansatsu wo monogatari ni ire rukotoni kanojo no kyoumi wo hikioko shimashita.

rows.question: Mariina kabutaraze no chichioya no rinshoushinrigaku no haikei ha kanojo no shippitsu ni eikyou wo atae masuka?
rows.answer: Hai, rinshoushinrigaku niokeru mariina kabutaraze no chichioya no shokugyouteki haikei ha, kanojo no tokuchou ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. kanojo ha hon ni fukuzatsu na shinriteki youso wo fukume, kyarakutaa ni fukami wo kuwae ru keikou gaarimasu.

rows.question: Ishi toshiteno mariya kabutaraze no hahaoya no shokugyou ha, kanojo no shippitsu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Ishi toshiteno mariina kabutaraze no hahaoya no shokugyou ha, kanojo no sensouchuu kokoro no hon ni teikiteki ni tenji sareteiru youso wo, ningen no kurushi mito omoiyari no reigaiteki na rikai wo kanojo ni atae mashita.

rows.question: Mariina kabutaraze no hon ha, (karera gasokode naniwo shitanoka: geteisubaagu no tatakai karano purofiiru) ha dokusha ya hihyouka ni kouhyou deshitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, (karera gasokodeshitakoto: geteisubaagu no tatakai karano purofiiru) mariina kabutaraze ha, sono senmei na setsumei to shinmitsu na kyarakutaa no byousha de hiroku shousan sareteimashita.

rows.question: Marina Kavtaradze no hon ni kurikaeshi no teema haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Marina Kavtaradze no hon deha, kurikaesa reru teema ha, gyakkyou ni chokumen shita ningen no kaifukuryoku no tankyuu, tokuni sensou no jidai desu.

rows.question: Naisen jidai ni settei sareta mariya kabutaraze no hon no monogatari sutairu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Marina Kavtaradze no hon ha, karera no yutaka de shousai na monogatato saishin no rekishiteki seikaku sade chuumoku sareteimasu. kanojo ha saadopaason no monogatari sutairu wo saiyou suru keikou gaari, ikutsukano shiten wo hori sage rukotogadekimasu.

rows.question: Tsugino hon ha nani ni torikun deimasuka?
rows.answer: Mariina kabutarajie ha genzai, yuuki noaru (yuuki no koe: ritchimondo no hiiroozu) ni torikun deori, nanbokusensou no tankyuu wo tsuzuke teimasu.

rows.question: Mariina kabutaraze ha kanojo no shippitsu dedonoyouna izen no keiken wo hikidashi teimasuka?
rows.answer: Kanojo no ryoushin ga shinriteki ni shuuchuuteki na shokugyou ni tsui teiru kazoku de sodatsu ta mariina kabutaraze ha, shibashiba kanojo no chosaku niokerukorerano eikyou ni modotsu te genkyuu shiteimasu. kanojo no hahaoya to chichi no shokugyou ha, kanojo no kyarakutaa no igakuteki oyobi seishinteki zokusei ni ookiku kouken shiteimasu.

rows.question: Mariina kabutarattsue ga kanojo no hon (Legacies of War: Soldiers) Tales from Antietam) notameni uketotsu ta fiidobakku toha nande suka?
rows.answer: (sensou no isan: heishi tachi) no antovaateierumu no monogatari) ha, sensou no heishi wo ningen kasu ru mariina kabutaraze no nouryoku wo shousan shi, karera no kunan, yuuki, soshite karera ga iki ta gekidou no jidai no senmei na e wo egai teimasu.

rows.question: Mariina kabutaraze ha, nanbokusensou no janru no juuyouna chosha to kangae rareteimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, mariina kabutaraze ha, kanojo no yuniiku na shiten, shousai na kenkyuu, settokuryoku noaru sutooriiteringu notameni, nanbokusensou no janru no shuyou na chosha to kangae rareteimasu.

rows.question: Mariina kabutaraze no haikei ha, kanojo no josei kyarakutaa no byousha nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae masuka?
rows.answer: Josei no chosha toshite, mariina kabutarado ha, tokuni sensou no kutsuu no bunmyaku de, kanojo no josei kyarakutaa no bimyou de kyoukan tekina byousha womotarashimasu. kanojo no kyarakutaa no tsuyosa to kaifukuryoku ha, ooku no baai, nanbokusensou jidai no josei no yakuwari to tousou wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: (seiki no sanbun) shou ni kuwae te, mariina kabutaraze ha bungaku heno kouken notameni hokano houhou de mitome raremashitaka?
rows.answer: (seiki no sanbun) shou wo kakutoku surukototoha betsuni, mariina kabutaraze no sakuhin ha ooku no purattofoomu de mitome rareteimasu. kanojo no hon no ooku ha, ikutsukano chomei na bungaku zasshi niyotte (besutoobuzaiyaa) toshite risuto sareteori, kanojo no sakuhin ha gakkou ya daigaku no karikyuramu deyoku shiyousa reteimasu.

rows.question: Nanbokusensou ni kansu ru mariina kabutaraze no shiten ha, kanojo no shippitsu kyaria no katei dedonoyouni shinka shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Kanojo no kyaria no han'i niwatatte, mariina kabutaraze no nanbokusensou no kenkai ha fukama ri, hiroga rimashita. kanojo no shoki no sakuhin deha, kanojo ha tatakai to senryaku nimotto shouten wo awa seteimashitaga, kanojo no nochino sakuhin ha, ningen no torauma, ippanno hitobito no taikyuusei, soshite sensou ga shakai wodonoyouni henkasa serukanitsuite, yori hori sage teimasu.

rows.question: 1975 nen 9 gatsu 24 nichi ni berugii no buryusseru de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Chosha no furuneemu ha janpieeruvandaaruu de, 1975 nen 9 gatsu 24 nichi ni berugii no buryusseru de umare mashita.

rows.question: Janpieeruvandaaruu no shippitsu no shuyou na janru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha omoni Wicca no janru ni kai teimasu.

rows.question: Janpieeruvandaaruu no ryoushin no shokugyou ni kansu ru jouhou wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Janpieeruvandaaruu no chichioya ha kyuukyuuiryou gijutsusha deari, kano hahaoya ha ryokoudairiten desu.

rows.question: Chosha no jan pieeru vandaaruu ga kano bungakusakuhin de kakutoku shita shou hadoredesuka?
rows.answer: Jan pieeru vandaaruu ha, kano shousetsu (ikyou no michi: kodoku na kaigyoui no tabi) ni taishi te sonkei sareru (shinpiteki na saakuru bungakushou) no jushousha desu.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ga Wicca no janru de shira reteiru hon no taitoru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha, (The Solitary Witch: Secrets from the Silent Mind), (Wiccan Ways: A Journey to the Spirit), (Mystic Shadows: Wicca no shinsei na saiban) nado, Wicca no janru niikutsukano chuumoku subeki taitoru wo kaki mashita.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ga Wicca no janru ni kaku youni unagashi takikkakeha nande suka?
rows.answer: Jan pieeru vandaaruu ha tsuneni, supirichuaritei to shizen mahou ni fukai kanshin wo motsu teite, uikka no janru ni omoni kaku toiu kano kettei ni eikyou wo atae mashita.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha Wicca igai no hokano janru ni chousen shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Uikka ha kano shuyou na janru nomamadesuga, jan pieeru vandaaruu ha tokiori, kodai ikyou no bunka ni kanrensu ru rekishi shousetsu wo hori sage mashita.

rows.question: Berugii no buryusseru deno janpieeruvandaaruu no ikusei ni kansu ru shousai wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Buryusseru no bunkateki ni yutaka na toshi de umare sodatsu ta janpieeruvandaaruu ha, berugii no dentou to gendai no yooroppa no eikyou no yuniiku na burendo wo ukeire mashita.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo no ikusei ha kano shippitsu shokugyou nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Tayou na bunkatekihaikei to buryusseru no yutaka na shinpishugi ha, janpieeruvandaaruu no souzouryoku to sutairu wo oohaba ni katazukuri, uikka bungaku no yuniiku na koe ninarimashita.

rows.question: Janpieeruvandaaruu no ryoushin no shokugyou ha, chosha toshiteno kano shiten nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Kinkyuuiryou gijutsusha toshiteno chichioya no shokugyou ha, janpieeruvandaaruu ni nama to shino bimyouna rikai wo atae mashitaga, ryokoudairiten toshiteno hahaoya no shokugyou ha, kare wosamazamana bunka to monogatari nisarashimashita.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ga sakusei shita saisho no hon ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ga shippitsu shita saisho no hon ha (Wicca: The Path of Nature) deshita.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo hadonokuraino hindo de atarashii hon wo hakkoushi masuka?
rows.answer: Heikin shite, janpieeruvandaaruu ha 2 nen gotoni atarashii hon wo koukai shiteimasu.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo no hon hadonoyouna gengo de riyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo no hon ha omoni eigo de shuppan sareteimasuga, furansu to oranda go nimo honyaku sareteimasu.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha kano hon de hokano sakka ya sakka to kyouryoku shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha omoni kodoku na chosha desuga, Wicca no rekishi to jissen ni kansu ruikutsukano sakuhin wo kyoucho shiteimasu.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha Wicca waakushoppu ya oopunkurasu wo jisshi shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, shippitsu toha betsuni, Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha buryusseru de Wicca no waakushoppu to kurasu wo itte ori, shinkou no forowaa tosorenitsuiteno koukishin no ryouhou no keikou gaarimashita.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha ryoushin no shokugyou ni motozu ite hon wo kai teimasuka?
rows.answer: Janpieeruvandaaruu no ryoushin no shokugyou ha kare ni fukaku eikyou wo atae mashitaga, kareha korera 2 tsuno shokugyou ni motozu ite hon wo meijiteki ni shippitsu shiteimasen.

rows.question: Wicca no janru deno Jean-Pierre Vanderloo no sakuhin ha, bungaku bunya nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo no sakuhin ha, Wicca no janru ni taisuru ooki na kanshin to ninshiki wo kari tate, bungaku noyori sonkei sare, hiroku yoma reta ryouiki ninarimashita.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo no sakuhin ni taisuru dokusha to hihyouka no hannou hadoudesuka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo no sakuhin ha, dokusha to hihyouka no ryouhou kara kouhyou wo hakushi teori, Wicca no jissen to miryokuteki na sutooriiteringu no dousatsu ni michi ta tankyuu wo shousan shiteimasu.

rows.question: Dokusha hadokode jan pieeru vandaaruu no hon wo kounyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo no hon ha, sekaijuu no shuyou na shoten ni kuwae te, Amazon ya Barnes & Noble nadono shuyou na onrainpurattofoomu de kounyuu dekimasu.

rows.question: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha kongo no purojiekuto ni torikun deimasuka?
rows.answer: Jean-Pierre Vanderloo ha genzai, tsugino taitoru (Spirits: A Wiccan Enchantment) toiu taitoru ni torikun deimasu.

rows.question: Burajiru no sanpauro de umare ta giron sareta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Gironchuu no chosha ha, burajiru no sanpauro de umare, gaburiera karasuko to nazuke rareteimasu.

rows.question: Shousan sareta nazo no chosha dearu gaburiera karasuko haitsu umare mashitaka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko ha 1989 nen 9 gatsu 16 nichi ni umare mashita.

rows.question: Chosha no gaburiera karasuko ha omoni kai teimasuka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko ha omoni misuterii no janru ni kai teori, kyoumi wososoru sasupensu noyouna monogatari wo tsukuriage teimasu.

rows.question: Gaburiera karasuko ga jushou shita yuumei na shou wo age temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko ha, nazo no bungaku heno kencho na kouken ni taishi te, meiyo aru (kuiru fezaa misuterii raitaa obu za nen) shou wo jushou shimashita.

rows.question: Gaburiera karasuko no ryoushin no shokugyou ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko no chichioya ha ryokoudairiten deari, hahaoya ha basu no untenshu toshite hatarai teimashita.

rows.question: Misuteriiraitaa no gaburierakarasuko niyotte sakusei sareta sakuhin noikutsukanitsuite genkyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Gaburierakarasuko no chuumoku subeki sakuhin niha, (In Shadows Deep (Luisa Santiago, # 1)) to (The Secret the Light (Detective Acacio, # 2)) gaarimasu.

rows.question: Gaburierakarasuko no burajiru no isan ha, kanojo no misuterii shousetsu nidonoyouni eikyou shimasuka?
rows.answer: Gaburierakarasuko no burajiru no isan ha, kanojo no misuterii shousetsu ni kakki ni michi ta haikei wo teikyou shi, shibashiba burajiru no bunka, rekishi, jimoto no nyuansu no youso wo toriire, kanojo no monogatari ni yutaka sato fukasa wo atae masu.

rows.question: Gaburiera karasuko ga kanojo no saisho no misuterii shousetsu wo shuppan shitatoki, nansai deshitaka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko ha 25 toshi de, saisho no misuterii shousetsu wo shuppan shi, sakka toshiteno seikou shita kyaria wo kaishi shimashita.

rows.question: Gaburiera karasuko ha kanojo no misuterii shousetsu dedonoyouna houkatsuteki na teema wo tankyuu shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko no misuterii shousetsu ha, shibashiba shinjitsu, gi ception, zen to aku no ningen no nouryoku, soshite ikken futsuu no joukyou ya hitobito ni kakusa reta nazo no teema wo tankyuu shimasu.

rows.question: Kanojo ga mitome rareteiru gaburierakarasuko no misuterii shousetsu no shomei youso mataha sutairu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko ha, kanojo no dainamikku de shitashimi yasui kyarakutaa, fukuzatsu na purotto, oyobi kyarakutaa no shinriteki fukasa no shousai na chousa to sasupensu wo ori komu nouryoku de shira reteimasu.

rows.question: Yuniiku na shokugyou no ryoushin tono gaburiera karasuko no haikei ha kanojo no shippitsu ni eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, gaburiera karasuko no haikei ha kanojo no shippitsu ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. kanojo ga chichioya dearu ryokoudairiten kara atsume ta chishiki ha, sekai nosamazamana chiiki de genjitsuteki de senmei na kankyou wo sakusei surunoni yakutachi mashita. basu no untenshu toshiteno kanojo no hahaoya no shokugyou ha, kanojo no monogatari deshibashiba medatsu youni tokuchou tosuru futsuu no hitobito no seikatsu nitsuiteno dousatsu wo kanojo ni teikyou shimashita.

rows.question: Gaburiera karasuko ha, misuteriiraitaa ninarutameni tokutei no toreeningu wo uke mashitaka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko ga nazo no sakka ninarutameni tokutei no toreeningu wo uke takadoukanitsuiteno seikaku na jouhou haarimasen. shikashi, fukuzatsu na nazo no monogatari wo sakusei suru kanojo no nouryoku ha, kono janru no kouhan na dokusho to kenkyuu wo tsuuji te, jikohyouka sareta, mataha era reru osora ku, fukai rikai wo shisashi teimasu.

rows.question: Gaburierakarasuko no kongo no hon wo kitai dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, fan ha gaburiera karasuko no tsugino misuterii shousetsu (daaku shadouzu oobaa touruusu (ruisa santeiago, # 2)) wo nesshin ni yosou dekimasu.

rows.question: Gaburiera karasuko ha hokano chosha to kyouryoku shitakotogaarimasuka?
rows.answer: Kyou made, hokano chosha to kyouryoku shiteiru gaburiera karasuko no kiroku haarimasen. kanojo no sakuhin ha kanojo ninomi shousan sareteimasu.

rows.question: Gaburierakarasuko wo (kuirufezaamisuteriiraitaaobuzaiyaa) shou wo jushou shita hon hadoredesuka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko ha, kanojo no hiroku hyouka sareteiru misuterii shousetsu (for shadows deep (Luisa Santiago, # 1) de (kuirufezaamisuteriiraitaaobuzaiyaa) shou wo jushou shimashita.

rows.question: Gaburierakarasuko no sakuhin ha misuteriijanru nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Gabriela Carrasco no sakuhin ha, kaihatsu sareta kyarakutaa, taiki kankyou, fukuzatsu na purotto no yuniiku na burendo de, misuterii no janru ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. kanojo hamata, burajiru no bunka wo kanojo no nazo ni chuunyuu shitakotode yuumei deari, dokusha ni shinsen de kakki noaru shiten wo teikyou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Gaburierakarasuko no hon ha shiriizu mataha sutandoaron no ichibu desuka?
rows.answer: Gaburierakarasuko no shousetsu ha, shibashiba shiriizu no ichibu wo keisei shi, (ruisasanteiago) shiriizu ya (tantei akashio) shiriizu nado, kurikaeshi yuniiku de dainamikku na kyarakutaa to jizokuteki na sutooriiaaku wo fiichaa shiteimasu.

rows.question: Gaburiera karasuko ha kanojo no shigoto ni taishi te kokusaiteki na shousan wo uke mashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, gaburiera karasuko ha, kanojo no hon gasamazamana gengo ni honyaku sare, sekaijuu de hiroku fukyuu shiteiru choushuu ni toutatsu shi, misuterii no janru no chomei na chosha toshite kanojo wo kakuritsu shi, kokusaiteki na shousan wo uke teimasu.

rows.question: Gaburiera karasuko no ryoushin ha sakka toshiteno kanojo no kyaria wo sapooto shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Gaburiera karasuko no shiseikatsu ni kansu ru odaya kana shousai ha, kanojo no ryoushin ga kanojo no kyaria no michi wo shiji shiteitakotowo shisashi teimasu. Carrasco ha, seikou shita shippitsu no kyaria wo, yuruginai shien to hagemashi ni hinpan ni kaeshi masu.

rows.question: Hokano media deno gaburierakarasuko no sakuhin no tekiou haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Genzai, eiga ya terebi nadono hokano media deno gaburierakarasuko no sakuhin no tekiou haarimasen. shikashi, kanojo no ninki no takama rito kanojo no monogatari no eiga no shitsu wo kangae ruto, kanojo no sakuhin no tekiou ga shouraiteki ninatteitemo odoroku kotodehaarimasen.

rows.question: 1990 nen 3 gatsu 13 nichi ni beikoku nyuuyooku shi de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: 1990 nen 3 gatsu 13 nichi ni beikoku nyuuyooku shi de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha, jonkentoburaddorii desu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii ga kai teiru shuyou na janru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii ha omoni yanguadarutoromansu no janru ni kai teimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii no ryoushin no shokugyou ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii no chichioya ha kajiya deari, kano hahaoya ha chousa jaanarisuto desu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii ha kano namae ni nanika shou wo motsu teimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, jon kento buraddorii ha, meiyo aru (yanguadarutobukku notameno Locus Award) no jushousha desu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii no ryoushin no shokugyou ha kano shippitsu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii no ryoushin no shokugyou ha kano shippitsu ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. fukuzatsu de kinben na kyarakutaa ha, chichioya no shokunin waza wo kajiya toshite han'ei shiteori, kontei niaru chousa purottosureddo ha, hahaoya no jaanarizumu no kyaria no eikyou wo shimeshi teimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii no mottomo yuumei na hon no 2 tsuni namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii no mottomo yuumei na hon no 2 tsuha, (shinkouchuu no jounetsu) to (gendai no rabusutoorii) to (Destiny's Twist: A Chance of Love) desu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii no hon no teema ya kyarakutaa ni keizokusei haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, jon kento buraddorii no hon no teema to kyarakutaa niha keizokusei gaarimasu. karera ha omoni, ooku no baai, wakai otona no romansu no janru to itchi suru shigoto no kankyou de, ai to jinsei wo nabigeeto suru wakai otona wo chuushin ni tenkai shimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii ha tokutei no shippitsu sutairu ni shitagatte imasuka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii no shippitsu sutairu ha, tokuni shin'en de kanjouteki ni miryokuteki deari, kanrensei ga takaku miryokuteki na houhou de wakai otona no romansu wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii hadonokuraino hindo de atarashii sakuhin wo koukai shimasuka?
rows.answer: Tokutei no pataan haarimasenga, jonkentoburaddorii ha tsuujou, 2 nen ni 1 kai atarashii shigoto wo koukai shiteimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii no shoki no jinsei wo shousai ni setsumei dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Nyuuyooku shi no kajiya to chousa jaanarisuto ni umare ta jon kento buraddorii no shoki no jinsei ha, buruukaraa no kachikan to koukishin kudougata no shinjitsu no tankyuu no kyoumibukai yuugou deari, nochini kano shippitsu ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii hadonoyounishite yanguadarutoromansu wo shippitsu shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii ha, kano dousatsu ni michi ta ikusei to ningen no kanjou to ningenkankei heno tsuyoi kanshin ni shokuhatsu sare, shizen ni wakai otona no romansu wo kaku kotoni hiki yose raremashita.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii no hon nohotondono settei ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii no hon nohotondoha, kakki ni michi ta toshi no fuukei ni settei sareteori, ooku no baai, kano kokyou no nyuuyooku shi no sawagi to bus sou wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii ha taagettooodiensu karadonoyouna hannou wo uke mashitaka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii ha, taagetto no choushuu kara attouteki na hakushu wo uke teori, kareha kyarakutaa no bimyouna byousha to miryokuteki na purottorain ni kanshashi teimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii no hon ni kyoutsuu no mochiifu haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii no hon no ippanteki na mochiifu ha, kunan ni chokumen shita ai no eizokusei deari, kojinteki oyobi shokugyouteki seikatsu no shougai wo kokufuku suru kinben na kyarakutaa niyotteshibashiba shouchou saremasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii ha shiriizu wo kaki mashitaka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii ha, jissaini (shinkouchuu no jounetsu: gendai no ai no monogatari), (ai no chousen: kokoro no konnan), (ai no shouri: saishuuteki ni fumeiryou) de kousei sareru (yoki senu ai no sanbusaku) toiu shiriizu wo kai teimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii ha, (Best Young Adult Book no Locus Award) wo uketotsu takotonidonoyouni hannou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii ha (Best Young Young Adult Book no Locus Award) wo uketotsu tatokini, kansha no kimochi wo hyoumei shi, dokusha to yorokobi wo kyouyuu shi, karera no sapooto ga kano seikou ni kouken shitakotowo mitome mashita.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii ha omoni kano hon ni shouten wo ate teirunohadonoyouna sokumen desuka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii ha, kano hon no naka de ai no kankei niokeru gyakkyou ni chokumen shita kanjouteki na seichou, kojintekina henyou, kaifukuryoku wo omoni tankyuu shiteimasu.

rows.question: Nyuuyooku shi hadonoyounishite jon kento buraddorii no chosaku wo haaku shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Nyuuyooku shi ha, kano hon no settei no daibubun toshite, jon kento buraddorii no shippitsu ni juuyouna yakuwari wo hata shiteimasu. soreha kano monogatari ga tenkai suru kakki ni michi ta kakki noaru haikei toshite kinoushi masu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii ha, kano yanguadarutoromansu shousetsu dedonoyouna shurui no kyarakutaa ni shouten wo ate ru keikou gaarimasuka?
rows.answer: Jon kento buraddorii ha tsuujou, ooku no baai, kyaria shikou mataha shokubakankyou nai de, ai to kojintekina seichou ni torikun deiru wakai dai ​ ​ nin no kyarakutaa wo egaku kotoni shouten wo ate teimasu.

rows.question: Jon kento buraddorii no shippitsu ha naganen niwatattedonoyouni shinka shitekimashitaka?
rows.answer: Naganen niwatari, jon kento buraddorii no shippitsu ha seijuku shiteori, kano sakuhin wo teigi suru kanjouteki na kanyo wo ijishi nagara, kankei no byousha to kano inbou no hatten no senren do no zouka wo shimeshi teimasu.

rows.question: Chosha no shoki no jinsei nitsuite kantan ni setsumeishi temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Chosha no Chiamaka Adebayo ha, 1931 nen 12 gatsu 1 nichi ni naijieria no ragosu de umare mashita. kanojo no chichioya ha baatendaa deari, hahaoya ha sainou noaru kenchikuka deshita.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo no bungaku no shouten ha nande shitaka? sono riyuu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Chiamaka Adebayo no bungaku no shouten ha, kimyou na janru niarimashita. kanojo ha, kojintekina keiken to bunkateki na fun'iki ni shokuhatsu sareta chosaku wo shiyoushi te, sekushuaritei to seibetsu no fukuzatsusa wo tankyuu shi, sonoyouna topikku gashibashiba tabuu datta jidai ni kyoukai wo oshi hiroge mashita.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo ga uketotsu ta yuumei na shou nitsuite oshie tekudasai.
rows.answer: Hai, Chiamaka Adebayo ha, 1995 nen ni bungaku no kinenhi tekina sakuhin, tokuni kuia no janru nai deno kinenhi tekina sakuhin notameni, fikushon notameni setsubou sareta orenji shou wo jushou shimashita.

rows.question: Chiamaka adebayo no ryoushin no senryou ha kanojo nidonoyouni eikyou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Chiamaka Adebayo no ryoushin ha, kanojo no sekai no shiten wo katazukuru uede juuyouna yakuwari wo hata shimashita. baatendaa toshiteno chichioya no kenkyo na shokugyou ha, kanojo wo kusanone no monogatari ni musubi tsuke, kenchikuka dearu hahaoya ga kanojo no bungakuteki na kouzou no fukuzatsu na nunoji de kansatsu dekiru kouzou to dezain heno ai wo uetsuke mashita.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo no hon noikutsukato, kimyou na janru nitotteno juuyousei nitsuite genkyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: (sutoonbutchiekoo), (nazo meita kokoro no kyuuden) nadono chiamakaadebayo no hon ha, kuiakomyunitei no kashisei to rikai ni kouken shite, kimyou na aidenteitei wo chuushin toshita monogatari no ryouhou ni torikun deimasu.

rows.question: Chiamaka adebayo no naijieria kigen ha kanojo no shippitsu ni yakuwari wo hata shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, Chiamaka Adebayo ha omoni kimyou na janru ni kai teimasuga, naijieria no isan no youso wo monogatari ni ori maze, kanojo no sakuhin ni yutaka na ta bunka no fukasa wo teikyou shi, kuia taiken no tayousei ni kansu ru kaiwa wo shourei shimasu.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo ha, kanojo ga janru wo eran datameni kadai ni chokumen shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, chiamaka adebayo ha, kanojo ga omoni kimyou na janru no nakani kai tanode, shakaiteki hanpatsu to henken ni chokumen shimashita. shikashi, kanojo hakorerano mushisa reta monogatari ni hikari wo ate ru doryoku ni koshitsu shi, yori houkatsuteki na bungakuteki keikan wo tsukuridasu tameno kanojo no shigoto no hitsuyousei wo yougo shimashita.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo niyoru (Stone Butch Echoes) no hon ni kansu ru shousaijouhou wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Chiamaka Adebayo no dokusouteki na sakuhin dearu (Stone Butch Echoes) ha, naijieria no kimyou na josei no genjitsu wo nabigeeto shi, shakaiteki kihan no naka de seibetsu to seiteki aidenteitei wo tankyuu shi, chosha no kojintekina keiken niaru teido han'ei sareteimasu.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo no (nazo meita kokoro no kyuuden) toha nande suka?
rows.answer: Chiamaka Adebayo ga shippitsu shita (Enigmatic Heart no kyuuden) ha, naijieria no bunkateki bunmyaku no haikei ni taisuru kimyou na romanchikku na kankei no shikou wo shigeki suru tankyuu deari, fukai fukami noaru fukami noaru ukeire to aidenteitei no mondai ni torikumu kotodesu.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo no hon ha hokano gengo ni honyaku sareteimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, Chiamaka Adebayo no sakuhin ha fukusuu no gengo ni honyaku sareteori, kanojo no kyouryoku na monogatari ga sekaiteki na choushuu ni todoki, samazamana bunka ni ooki na eikyou wo atae rukotowo hoshou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo no shippitsu sutairu ha naganen niwatattedonoyouni shinka shitekimashitaka?
rows.answer: Naganen niwatari, Chiamaka Adebayo no shippitsu sutairu ha, guroobaru na bunmyaku niokeru seibetsu to sekushuaritei ni kansu ru seijuku shita gensetsu wo han'ei shite, kimyou na aidenteitei noyori bimyouna byousha wo kumikomu tameni shinka shimashita.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo ha shousetsu igai no hokano bungakuteki na katachi ni kouken shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, shousetsu to naran de, Chiamaka Adebayo ha, kanojo no shinnen wo han'ei shi, samazamana kakudo kara kimyou na keiken wo tera suikutsukano tanpen, essei, shi wo kaki mashita.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo ha, kanojo no kojintekina shinnen to keiken ni kanrensu ru katsudou ni kanyo shiteimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, Chiamaka Adebayo ha jinken to kimyou na ukeire no nesshin na yougo mono deari, korerano mondai wo kyouchou surutameni kanojo no purattofoomu wo hinpan ni shiyoushi mashita. kanojo no koudoushugi ha kanojo no sakuhin ni shintou shi, kanojo ha chosha dakedenaku, shakaitekibunmyaku no senkusha ninarimashita.

rows.question: Chiamaka Adebayo no sakuhin ha bungaku komyunitei nai dedonoyouni uketora remashitaka?
rows.answer: Chiamaka Adebayo no sakuhin ha, sono uno shinraisei to kimyou na monogatari no senkuteki na tankyuu notameni, bungaku komyunitei nai de shousan sareteimasu. kanojo ha, shouheki wo yaburi, bungaku no kimyou na aidenteitei no kakudai suru hyougen ni ookiku kouken shita yuuki aru koe toshite mitome raretekimashita.

rows.question: Queer no janru nai de Chiamaka Adebayo niyotte kaka reta betsuno shousetsu ni namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?

rows.question: Chosha no Adwoa Ampomah ga jushou shita shou ni namae wo tsukeru kotohadekimasuka?
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah ha, bungaku niokeru doubutsu no janru heno kouken nitsuite, meiyo aru (Nnedi Okorafor African bungakushou) ni mitome rareteimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah no haikei ha, tokuni doubutsu no janru nioite, kanojo no shippitsu nidonoyouni eikyou shimasuka?
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah no gaana no ruutsu to ikusei ha, doubutsu no janru deno kanojo no shippitsu ni ooki na eikyou wo atae teimasu. kanojo no shusshin no gaana ha, yutaka na tayousei no yasei seibutsu wo hokotsu teori, kanojo no hon ni juubun na sozai to insupireeshon wo teikyou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah no doubutsu no janru no hon taitoru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah ga doubutsu no janru ni kai ta hon no taitoru niha, (The Lion and the Gazelle) to (Journey of the Starling: A Tale of Courage) ga fukuma remasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah ha, kanojo no hon no naka de doubutsu to bungaku heno ai wodonoyouni kumiawase teimasuka?
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah ha, doubutsu no janru wo shiyoushi te, yasei seibutsu nitsuiteno ninshiki to rikai wo umidasu kokoroatatama ru settokuryoku noaru monogatari wo katatsu teimasu. kanojo no hon hashibashiba doubutsu no kyarakutaa wo shiyoushi te, ningen no kanjou to shakaiteki teema wo tankyuu shimasu.

rows.question: Hihyouka to dokusha ha, adouoa anpoma no doubutsu wo teema nishita hon nidonoyouni hannou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah no hon ha, karera no dokusousei, kanjou no fukasa, yasei seibutsu no senmei na byousha notameni kangei sareteimasu. hihyouka ha, doubutsu monogatari wo shiyoushi te ningen no joutai wo tera su nouryoku wo takaku hyouka shiteimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah no hon (The Lion and the Gazelle) ni kansu ru jouhou wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: (raion to gazeru) ha, gaana no kouya wo butai nishita seizon to yuujou no ribetto noaru monogatari desu. raion to gazeru no monogatari wo toushi te, Adwoa Ampomah ha gyakkyou, kaifukuryoku, soshitearisoumonai yuujou no chikara no teema wo saguri masu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah ha, kanojo no chosho (Journey of the Starling: A Tale of Couray) nidonoyouna teema wo atsukatsu teimasuka?
rows.answer: (sutaaringu no tabi: yuuki no monogatari) deha, adoua anpoma ha, chourui no shujinkou to isshoni bouken ni dokusha wo tsure te iku yuuki, jiko hakken, kankyou no suchuwaadoshippu no teema ni torikun deimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah no jushou reki noaru hon ha, kanojo no kyaria to bungaku komyunitei nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: (Nnedi Okorafor African bungakushou) wo kakutoku shitakotode, Adwoa Ampomah hasarani supottoraito ni ochiiri, doubutsu no janru bungaku no juuyouna koe toshiteno kanojo no tachiba wo kakuninshi mashita. soreha kanojo no dokusha wo fuyashi, kanojo no shigoto niyori ooku no kokusaiteki na chuumoku wo atsume mashita.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah no shippitsu sutairu nitsuite kuwashiku oshie tekudasai.
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah no shippitsu sutairu ha, sono kijutsuteki na seishitsu to kanjouteki na fukasa niyotte tokuchouzuke raremasu. kanojo ha doubutsu no kyarakutaa wo gijinka suru kotsu wo motsu teori, dokusha ni kanrensei noarumononishi, fukuzatsu na teema wosorerawo toushi te tansaku dekiruyounishimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah ga genzai torikun deiru kongo no purojiekuto ya hon haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah ha kanojo no kongo no sakuhin nitsuite sukoshi himitsu desuga, kanojo ha genzai, kanojo no kakuritsu sareta pataan ni shitagatte, tashikani doubutsu no janru wo fukumu atarashii sakuhin wo kisou shiteirukotoga shira reteimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah ha, doubutsu no janru igai ni hokano janru no hon wo kai teimasuka?
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah ha doubutsu no janru deno sakuhin de mottomo yuumei desuga, rekishiteki na fikushon ya ningen no dainamikusu nadono janru de mihappyou no sakuhin moari, sakka toshiteno kanojo no han'i wo kyouchou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah ha, kanojo no sakuhin noizurekade hokano sakka ya geijutsuka to kyouryoku shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Adwoa Ampomah ha, samazamana aateisuto, tokuni neiteibu no gaana no irasutoreetaa to kyouryoku shitekimashita.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah no sakuhin ha hokano gengo ni honyaku sareteimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, Adwoa Ampomah no sakuhin ha, furansu go, supein go, doitsu go wo fukumu fukusuu no gengo ni honyaku sareteori, kanojo no kokusaiteki na miryoku wo shoumeishi teimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah ga gaana no bungaku shiin nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Yuniiku na teema ni torikumi, ikkan shite kouhinshitsu no hon wo haishin surukotode, adouoaanpoma ha gaana no bungaku shiin ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. kanojo ha jibunjishin de kokusaiteki na ninshiki wo eta dakedenaku, gaana no bungaku shiin wo guroobaru na butai ni oi teimasu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah ga kanojo no hon wo toushi te tsutae runoga suki na saihatsu no teema ya messeeji haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Kankyouhozen toarayuru keitai no seikatsu heno keii ha, Adwoa Ampomah no hon no kurikaeshi no teema desu. kanojo no monogatari wo toushi te, kanojo ha yasei seibutsu ga chokumen suru kadai to seibutsu tayousei no juuyousei wo ninshiki shimasu.

rows.question: Gaana deno Adwoa Ampomah no oitachi ha, kanojo no hon no naka de doubutsu no byousha nidonoyouni eikyou shimasuka?
rows.answer: Gaana de sodatsu ta Adwoa Ampomah ha, yasei seibutsu ni michi ta shizen no keikan nisarasaremashita. wakai goro kara hagukuma reta doubutsu ni taisuru kanojo no ai to keii ha, kanojo ga kyoumi wososoru doubutsu no kyarakutaa ni koe wo atae rutoki, kanojo no hon ni araware masu.

rows.question: Adwoa Ampomah no doubutsu sedai no bungaku niokeru sakuhin wo kubetsu surumonoha nande suka?
rows.answer: Kanojo no doubutsu no kyarakutaa no mawari no miwakuteki de kangae saserareru monogatari wo ori komu adouoa anpoma no nouryoku ha, doubutsu no sedai no bungaku de kanojo no sakuhin wo kubetsu shiteimasu. doubutsu no koudou ni taisuru kanojo no surudoi dousatsu to, ningen no koudou to hannou wo han'ei surutameno doubutsu no all hanashiteki na shiyou ha, kanojo no sakuhin wo kiwa tata semasu.

rows.question: 1992 nen 3 gatsu 5 nichi ni chuugoku no honkon de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Chosha no furuneemu ha burendarai desu.

rows.question: Burenda rai ga kai teiru shuyou na janru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai ha omoni rezubian no janru ni kai teimasu.

rows.question: Burendarai no ryoushin no shokugyou wo watashi ni teikyou shitemoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Burendarai no ryoushin no shokugyou ha, zaisei to houritsu no bunya niarimasu. kanojo no chichioya ha kaikeishi deari, hahaoya ha renshuu bengoshi desu.

rows.question: Burenda rai ha kanojo no bungakuteki na kouken ni taishi te chuumoku subeki shou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, burenda rai ha, (ronarudo sukenake no kakushinteki na fikushonkontesuto) no hi tekisetsu na (kakushinteki na fikushonkontesuto) no jushousha desu.

rows.question: Burendarai no chomei na hon ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai no mottomo chomei na sakuhin niha, (nami no mano iki) to (watashi no ichibu) ga fukuma remasu.

rows.question: Burenda rai no (watashi no ichibu) no haigo niaru insupireeshon ha nande suka?
rows.answer: (A Fue of Me) ha, burendarai no kojintekina aidenteitei to kanjouteki na shinmitsu sano tankyuu ni shokuhatsu sare, kanojo no rezubian no janru to itchi shiteimashita.

rows.question: Burenda rai no shusseichi dearu honkon ha, kanojo no chosaku nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Bunkateki narutsubodearu burenda rai no hasshou no chi dearu honkon ha, tayou na monogatari wo kanojo ni teikyou shimashita.

rows.question: (nami no mano iki) de burenda rai no shippitsu sutairu nitsuite setsumeishi teitadakemasuka?
rows.answer: (nami no mano iki) de, burenda rai ha shiteki na sanbun to kanjouteki na uno yuugou wo saiyou shiteori, kanojo no rezubian no kyarakutaa no shinmitsu na kankei wo tankyuu suru miryokuteki na monogatari womotarashimasu.

rows.question: Chosha no burenda rai no ichibu ha dare desuka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai ha, baajinia urufu ya arisu uookaa noyouna chosha ga, tokuni rezubian no janru de sakka toshite kanojo wo katazukuru uede juuyou dearutoshibashiba nobe mashita.

rows.question: Burenda rai no sakuhin ha, omoni tokutei no teema ni shouten wo ate teimasuka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai no sakuhin ha, rezubian no sakka toshiteno kanojo no keiken to kenkai wo han'ei shite, aidenteitei, ukeire, ai no teema ni omoni shouten wo ate teimasu.

rows.question: Burenda rai no yuniiku na haikei ha kanojo no shippitsu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Honkon deno burenda rai no yuniiku na haikei to puro no bunya no ryoushin niyotte sodate rarerukotoha, shakai no fukuzatsu na dainamikusu wo tankyuu shi, bunsekiteki na shippitsu sutairu ni kouken shiteimasu.

rows.question: Burendarai no saishin no hon ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai no saishin no hon ha, (ekoo sairensu) deari, 2 nin no josei mano shinmitsu sato chinmoku no settokuryoku noaru tankyuu desu.

rows.question: Burenda rai ha kanojo no shippitsu no kyaria ni nanika kadai ni chokumen shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Rezubian no sakka toshite, burenda rai ha, sutereotaipu ya hyougen no mondai wo fukumu kanojo no tabi de kadai ni chokumen shiteimasu.

rows.question: Dokusha no burenda rai no (watashi no ichibu) ni taisuru hannou hadoudeshitaka?
rows.answer: Dokusha ha (watashi no ichibu) wo attouteki ni takaku hyouka shi, monogatari no naka de nama to kokoro wo utsu kanjou wo egaku burenda rai no nouryoku wo shousan shimashita.

rows.question: Burenda rai no (nami no mano iki) ha kanojo no kojintekina keiken wodonoyouni han'ei shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: (nami no mano kokyuu) ha, burenda rai no kojintekina keiken, tokuni kanojo no kankei to kojintekina aidenteitei no nabigeeshon wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Burenda rai no ikusei to kazoku no bakkuguraundo ha, kanojo no shippitsu dedonoyouna houhou wo shimeshi teimasuka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai no ikusei, tokuni kanojo no kazoku no zaisei to houritsu no shokugyou ueno haikei ha, shibashiba kanojo no hon no kyarakutaa no dainamikusu to shakaikouzou no byousha ni shintou shimasu.

rows.question: (ronarudo sukenikku kakushinteki na fikushon kontesuto) shou ha, burenda rai no kyaria nidonoyouni eikyou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: (Ronald Sukenick Innovative Fiction Contest) de yuushou surukotode, tokuni kanojo ga omoni kai teiru janru nai de, sonkei sareru sakka toshiteno burendarai no chii wo kyouka shimashita.

rows.question: Burenda rai no ryoushin ha kanojo no bungaku no seikou nidonoyouni hannou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai no ryoushin ha, kanojo no seikou wo shiji shi, hokori ni omotte ori, kanojo no shippitsu no shin ity sei to kanojo ga bungaku no naka de atae ta purasu no eikyou wo rikai shiteimasu.

rows.question: Brenda Lai no kongo no purojiekuto ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai ha genzai, zanteiteki ni (sasayakino hansei) toiu taitoru no tsugino shousetsu ni torikun deori, futatabi rezubian no kankei no teema wo tankyuu shiteimasu.

rows.question: Burenda rai ha kanojo no sakuhin de naniwo tassei shitaito omotte imasuka?
rows.answer: Burenda rai ha, rezubian no kankei no fukuzatsusa ni hikari wo ate taito kangae teori, kanojo no shippitsu wo tsuuji te komyunitei nai no keiken wo hyougen shi, kenshou surukotowo mezashi teimasu.

rows.question: 1974 nen ni betonamu no hoochimin shi de umare ta kakuu no chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: 1974 nen ni betonamu no hoochimin shi de umare ta kakuu no chosha no furuneemu ha, Nguyen Thanh Phong desu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong no kodomojidai to kano ryoushin no shokugyou nitsuiteno shousai wo oshie temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, betonamu no hoochimin shi no shougakkou no kyoushi to pesutoriishiefu ni umare mashita. kano ryoushin ha, osanaikoro kara kano chiteki oyobi souzouteki na hatten ni fukaketsu na yakuwari wo hata shimashita.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong ga mottomo yuumei na shippitsu no janru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, kurieiteiburaiteingugaido no janru heno kouken de mottomo yuumei desu. kano fukai chishiki to kokoro ni tsuyoku uttae ru sutairu ha, ooku no iyokuteki na sakka wo tasuke tekimashita.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong no chuumoku subeki sakuhin ni namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong niyoru chuumoku subeki sakuhin niha, (Advanced WorldBuilding: a Creative Writing Guide) to (Leading like a Writer: A Guide of Books) tosorerawo kaki tai nin notameno gaido ga fukuma remasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha kano sakuhin ni taishi te shou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, shippitsu to kyouiku heno juuyouna kouken ni taishi te, meiyo aru fikushon sakka no shuutoku shou wo jushou shimashita.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong no hon (Advanced WorldBuilding: A Creative Writing Guide) ni kansu ru shousaijouhou wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong niyoru (Advanced WorldBuilding: A Creative Writing Guide) ha, fikushon no shippitsu ni miryokuteki de botsunyuu kata no sekai wo kouchiku surutameno shousai na chishiki to jitsuyouteki na hinto wo teikyou suru houkatsuteki na gaido desu. soreha ooku no iyokuteki na sakka nitotte teiban tonatteimasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong niyoru (sakka noyouni yomu: hon wo aisu ru hitobito tosorerawo kaki tai nin notameno gaido) toiu hon no shouten ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Kono hon ha, dokusha ga sakka no me wo toushi te bungaku wo tankyuu surukotowo shourei shiteimasu. Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, sutooriiteringu wo seikou sase, miryokuteki na kyarakutaa ya monogatari wo sakusei surutoiu nyuansu no juuyouna youso wo setsumeishi teimasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, kare wo hokano sakka to kiwa tata seru shippitsu gaido no janru ni naniwo motarashimasuka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong no oshie rukotoni taisuru yuniiku na apuroochi ha, kano yutaka na bunkatekihaikei to, gendai no sutooriiteringutekunikku no inshouteki na rikai wo kumiawase teimasu. kareha akusesu shiyasuku, dousatsuryoku ni ton deirukotode shuku wareteimasu.

rows.question: Dokusha to sakka ha, Nguyen Thanh Phong no shigoto nidonoyouni hannou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Dokusha mo sakka mo douyou ni, kano meikaku de houkatsuteki na gaido de Nguyen Thanh Phong wo shousan shiteimasu. iyokuteki na chosha no ooku ha, karera no seikou ga kano oshie ni kiin suruto kangae teimasu. kano kouken niyori, souzouteki na shippitsu no sekai ni eizokuteki na eikyou ga nokotsu teimasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong no hasshou no chi dearu Ho Chi Minh City ha, kano shigoto nidonoyouna imi gaarimasuka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong no hasshou no chi dearu Ho Chi Minh City ha, kano sakuhin ni yuniiku na shiten wo chuunyuu shiteimasu. betonamu no kakki ni michi ta bunka to rekishi ha, sutooriiteringu to sekai kouchiku ni taisuru kano apuroochi ni tsuyoku eikyou shimasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong no yuumei na sakka ninarutameno michi wo kuwashiku setsumei dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Osanaikoro kara, kyoushi no chichioya to souzouteki na hahaoya ni shigeki sareta Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, shomen ni tsuyoi kanshin wo shimeshi mashita. kenshin to eizokuteki na renshuu de, kareha jikan no keika totomoni jibun no gijutsu wo migaki, shippitsu gaido no janru de meisei wo ema shita.

rows.question: Shougakkou no kyoushi toshiteno Nguyen Thanh Phong no chichioya no shokugyou ha, kano kyaria nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Shougakkou no kyoushi toshiteno kano chichioya no shokugyou ha, Nguyen Thanh Phong ni kyouiku tosono henkaku chikara ni taisuru kansha wo uetsuke mashita.

rows.question: Pesutoriishiefu toshiteno Nguyen Thanh Phong no hahaoya no shokugyou ha, kano shippitsu sutairu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong no hahaoya ha, pesutoriishiefu toshite, kano souzousei to saibu heno chuui ni eikyou wo atae mashita. kano shippitsu hashibashiba, komakai pesutorii no sakusei ni kanyo suru purosesu toha kotona ri, fukuzatsu na keikaku to shousai no yutaka sawo shimeshi masu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong ga kano shippitsu kyaria de chokumen shita kadai ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Ooku no chosha to douyou ni, Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, taagettooodiensu ni toutatsu shi, kyousou ni chousen shi, gaido wo houkatsuteki katsu doukizuke tsuzuke ru atarashii houhou wo tsuneni mitsu keteirunadono kadai wo toushi te sousa shinakerebanarimasendeshita.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, kano shippitsu igai no bungaku nidonoyouni kouken shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Kano zessan sareta hon toha betsuni, Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, kandouteki na shippitsu waakushoppu wo jisshi shi, bungaku matsuri ni sanka surukotodemo shira reteimasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong no tanjounen (1974 nen) ha, shippitsu to bungaku nitsuiteno kano shiten wodonoyouni katachizukuri ttanodeshouka?
rows.answer: 1974 nen ni umare ta Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, suujuunen niwatatte bungaku no henka de seichoushi tekimashita. koreha, kano shippitsu ni taisuru mitooshi ni eikyou wo atae, kareha dentouteki na monogatari no kouzou to gendai no sutooriiteringu no tekunikku no mano hashi wo kake mashita.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong no roudourinri nitsuiteno dousatsu wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, kano kiritsu aru shippitsu youjou hou, saishin no kenkyuu, oyobi kano gijutsu heno komittomento de shira reteimasu. kano roudourinri ha, kouhinshitsu no raiteingugaidobukku no kano ikkan shita seiseibutsu no omoni sekinin gaarimasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong no souzouteki na shippitsu ni taisuru apuroochi ha, kano hon nidonoyouni han'ei sareteimasuka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, souzouteki na shippitsu ni kansu ru hon no naka de, toujoujinbutsu no tamashii to honshitsu wo rikai surukotowo kyouchou shiteimasu. kareha, iyokuteki na sakka ga honmono ni kai te, karera no yuniiku na raiteingu no koe wo kaihatsu surukotowo shourei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong ga kano kyaria ni nori dashi ta koraboreeshon ya paatonaashippu haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong no koraboreeshon ha puraibeeto ni tamota reteimasuga, kareha shibashiba shuudan no souzousei no kachi wo hyoumei shi, samazamana intabyuu ya kouen de kyoudou inishiachibu ni hiraka retamonowo shimeshi teimasu.

rows.question: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, shippitsu to bungaku no sekai ni saru noga suki na isan deshouka?
rows.answer: Nguyen Thanh Phong ha, shinkou no sakka ni chikara wo atae, shippitsu no gijutsu ni taisuru fukai kansha wo uetsuke rukotowo mezashi teimasu. kano mokuhyou ha, insupireeshon, keihatsu, soshite souzouteki na shippitsu ni apuroochi suru houhou ni kansu ru kakudai sareta shiten no isan wo nokosu kotodesu.

rows.question: 1950 nen 2 gatsu 10 nichi ni azerubaijan no bakuu de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: 1950 nen 2 gatsu 10 nichi ni azerubaijan no bakuu de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha, isukandaa ganizade desu.

rows.question: Iskander Ganizadeh no chosaku no senmon ya janru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Iskander Ganizadeh ha, kano chosaku no janru toshite ikyou wo senmon toshiteimasu.

rows.question: Iskander Ganizadeh no ryoushin no shokugyou ni kansu ru shousai wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Iskander Ganizadeh no chichioya ha choukaku samurai deari, choukaku shougai to baransu shougai no shindan to chiryou wo senmon tosuru senmonka deshita. ippou, kano hahaoya ha fasshondezainaa deshita.

rows.question: Iskander Ganizadeh niyotte kaka reta hon noikutsukani namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Iskander Ganizadeh niyotte kaka reta hon noikutsukaniha, (Cybele no fukkatsu), (ushinawa reta musume no monogatari), (Cybele no ekoo), (houki sareta otome no f hanashi) ga fukuma reteimasu.

rows.question: Iskander Ganizadeh ha tokubetsu na shou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, Iskander Ganizadeh ha, ikyou no bungaku heno kencho na kouken ni taishi te Shankar no kokusai shou wo jushou shimashita.

rows.question: Ikyou no janru de isukandaa ganizade niyotte kaka reta saisho no hon ha nande suka?
