rows.question: Sara van daiku no chosho (Invisible Chains: rikai no rikai) ha, mentaruherusu no ninshiki nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Sara van daiku no chosho (Invisible Chains: Underning Mental Captivity) ha, mentaruherusu no ninshiki ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita.

rows.question: Sara van daiku no shippitsu ha, kanojo no chosho (The War in: A Survivor's Tale of Mental Insionor) ni motozu ite, seishin shikkan ni kurushi mu kojin nidonoyouni kibou womotarashimasuka?
rows.answer: Sara van daiku no chosho (The War nai: seizonsha no seishin shikkan no monogatari) ha, seizonsha no seikou monogatari wo kyouyuu surukotode seishin shikkan ni kurushi mu kojin ni kibou womotarashimasu.

rows.question: (mentaruherusu bungaku no toudai shou) noyouna shakaiteki ninshiki ha, mentaruherusu bungaku niokeru saravandaiku no shinchou wo takame mashitaka?
rows.answer: Tashikani, (mentaruherusu bungaku ni taisuru toudai shou) noyouna shakaiteki ninshiki ha, mentaruherusu bunken niokeru saravandaiku no shinchou wo takame tadakedenaku, mentaruherusu no mondai wo kouzen to giron surukotono juuyousei ni taisuru kokumin no chuui wo takame mashita.

rows.question: Saravandaiku ha, kanojo no shippitsu de minami afurika no isan wodonoyouni shiyoushi mashitaka?
rows.answer: Sara van daiku ha, jimoto no hougen, bunkateki genkyuu, minami afurika no fuukei no senmei na setsumei wo shiyoushi te, minami afurika no isan wo kanojo no sakuhin ni utsukushiku toriire, haikei dakedenaku, kanojo no monogatari no fukaketsu na bubun nishiteimasu.

rows.question: Saravandaiku no haikei no tayousei ha, kanojo no shippitsu kyaria no riten deshitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, minami afurika deno kanojo no ikusei ya ryoushin no tayou na shokugyou heno roshutsu wo fukumu sara van daiku no haikei no tayousei ha akiraka ni riten deari, kanojo no shippitsu ni fuki komu tameno kanojo no yuniiku na shiten wo teikyou shimasu.

rows.question: Mentaruherusujanru no saravandaiku niha, donoyouna shourai no sakuhin ga kitai dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Tokutei no sakuhin hamada akiraka nisareteimasenga, dokusha ha, seishintekikenkou no tayou na sokumen wo tankyuu suru saravandaiku noyori dousatsu ni ton da monogatari wo tanoshimi nishiteimasu.

rows.question: Sara van daiku ha kanojo no shippitsu dedonoyouna yuniiku na sutairu wo saiyou shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Sara Van Dyke ha, fukuzatsu na sutooriiteringu to jijitsu no jouhou wo yuugou sase, kanjouteki ni settokuryoku gaari, seishintekikenkou nitsuite kyouikuteki na monogatari wo ori komu sutairu wo saiyou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Saravandaiku ha, kanojo no hon wo toushi te mentaruherusu no bunya nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Kanojo no hon wo toushi te, sara van daiku ha, seishintekikenkou ni kansu ru giron nioite, seishin shikkan ni kanrensu ru suteiguma wo bunkai shi, seishintekikenkou ni kansu ru oopun na kaiwa wo shourei surunoni yakutachi mashita.

rows.question: Mentaruherususekutaa niokeru saravandaiku no shigoto no eikyou wodonoyouni setsumei dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Saravandaiku no sakuhin no eikyou ha, henkaku teki dearuto setsumei dekimasu. kanojo no dousatsu ni ton da monogatari ha, ooku no nin to kyoumei shi, seishintekikenkou no taiwa notameno anzen na kuukan wo hagukumi, seishin shikkan ni kurushi ndeiru hitobito noshibashiba mioto saregachina keiken ni hikari womotarashimashita.

rows.question: Mentaruherusu no bunken shiin de saravandaiku no hon wo kiwa tata seru dokutoku no tokuchou haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Sara van daiku no hon no dokutoku no tokuchou ha, seishintekikenkou no fukuzatsu na sokumen to kojintekina monogatari wo karama seru kanojo no nouryoku deari, dokusha wo kanjouteki ni toushi shi tsuzuke ru kyoukan tekina monogatari wo tsukuridashi masu. kanojo no minami afurika no ruutsu mo kagayaki, mentaruherusu no gensetsu no naka de yuniiku na bunkateki shiten wo teikyou shimasu.

rows.question: 1965 nen 2 gatsu 19 nichi ni mareeshia no kuararunpuuru de umare ta LGBTQ+ chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Chosha no furuneemu ha, mareeshia de umare, LGBTQ+ to shikibetsu saretatame, fusawashii namae dearu Adira Bintang desu.

rows.question: Adira bintan ha omoni kanojo no chosaku de shira reteiru janru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Adira Bintang ha omoni rezubian no janru ni kai teori, sono komyunitei ni kanrensu ru monogatato shiten wo tankyuu shiteimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no ryoushin no haikei ha nande suka? soreha kanojo no shippitsu nidonoyouni eikyou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Adira bintan no chichioya ha denki gishi deari, hahaoya ha kaunseraa deshita. katai shintaiteki roudou to kanjouteki chisei nokono yuniiku na kumiawase ha, kanojo no shippitsu sutairu ni ooki na eikyou wo atae, kyoukan tekina tamashii wo motome ruto karami atsu ta gutaiteki na guritto wo teikyou shimashita.

rows.question: Adira Bintang ga kanojo no kyaria de kai ta hon no taitoru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Adira Bintang no hon no taitoru niha, (watashi no ichibu), (nami no mano iki), (kanjou no denki), (kokoro no kaunseraa), (chinmoku no nakano noizu) nado, subete rezubian no janru to itchi shiteimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no (kanjou no denki) no haigo niaru monogatari nitsuite sukoshi kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: (kanjou no denki) ha, chichioya no boueki wo haikei ni, kanojo no arata na seiteki aidenteitei wo nabigeeto suru wakai josei no monogatari wo katatsu teimasu. koreha, kanojo no kojintekina keiken no tayou na youso womatomarinoaru monogatari nimatomerutoiu adira bintan no nouryoku no kyouryoku na shou desu.

rows.question: Adira bintan ha kanojo no sakuhin ni taishi te shou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Tashikani, adira bintan ha, rezubian bungaku heno kouken ni taishi te meiyo aru (reinboopen shou) wo juyo saremashita.

rows.question: Adira Bintang niyoru (nami no mano kokyuu) ha, kanojo no mareeshia no ruutsu wodonoyouni han'ei shiteimashitaka?
rows.answer: (nami no mano kokyuu) ha, kuararunpuuru shakai no kakki ni michi ta shiin wo egaki, jimoto no bunka, ryouri no yorokobi, kougo no taiwa wo ori, sono kaku tonaru monogatari wo oginai masu. soreha, adira bintan no shusseichi tono kojintekina kankei wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no shippitsu no teema ha, kanojo no kyaria no han'i dedonoyouni shinka shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Omoni jiko hakken ni shouten wo ate ta kanojo no saisho no sakuhin kara, adira bintan nosono nochino sakuhin ha, rezubian no janru ni chuujitsu dearinagara, fukuzatsu na taijinkankei to aidenteitei no kousa sei wo tankyuu surutameno shinka wo shimeshi teimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang ha, bungaku no LGBTQ+ komyunitei no hyougen nidonoyouna yakuwari wo hata shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Adira Bintang ha, LGBTQ+ komyunitei no dokusouteki na koe deari, kanojo no purattofoomu wo shiyoushi te, komyunitei nai no tayousei, tousou, yorokobi wo kyouchou suru sutoorii wo sakusei shi, soreniyotteyori fukai rikai to houkatsu sei wo sokushin shimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang ga hakkoushi ta saishin no hon ha nande suka? sono purotto wo gaisetsu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Adira Bintang no saishin no hon ha (The Noise In Silence) desu. koreha, mareeshia no inaka no myuutorezubian no josei ga, shakaiteki souon no naka de koe to aidenteitei wo hakken shitakotonitsuiteno miwakuteki na monogatari desu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no shippitsu purosesu ni kansu ru dousatsu wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Adira bintan ha, shibashiba kanojo no kojintekina keiken ya kankyou kara insupireeshon wo ete imasu. kanojo ha, saishin no chuui wo haratsu te, miryokuteki na shippitsu sutairu no tokuchou dearu shiryo fukaku hattatsu shita kyarakutaa wo sakusei surunoni tadai na jikan wo tsuiyashi teimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no sakuhin niha, kurikaeshi no shinboru ya mochiifu haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Mizu hashibashiba, adira bintan no sakuhin toshite, inochi wo atae ru chikara to kyodai na chikara to senzaiteki na hakai no jittai toshiteno sakuhin toshite araware, kanojo no kyarakutaa no seikatsu no keiken no nijuusei wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no yuniiku na ikusei to haikei ha kanojo nidonoyouni eikyou shimashitaka
rows.answer: Kanojo no nikutairoudou to kanjouteki na kyoukan no ryouhou heno roshutsu ha, adira ni yuniiku na shiten wo atae, kanojo no sakuhin no kyarakutaa to keiken wo honmono ni hyougen dekiruyounishimashita.

rows.question: Adira Bintang gasamazamana shippitsu ni chousen suru keikaku haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Koremadenotokoro, Adira Bintang niyorusamazamana janru wo hori sage ru keikaku no koukai happyou haarimasen. kanojo ha rezubian wo teema nishita monogatari wo seisan surukotoni sennen shiteimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang ha kanojo no kyaria de hokano sakka to kyouryoku shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Koremade, Adira Bintang ha kokono sakuhin no seisaku ni shouten wo ate tekimashitaga, kanojo ha shippitsu ni taisuru samazamana LGBTQ+ no chosha no eikyou to insupireeshon wo kouzen to mitome teimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no hon ga shakai ni ooki na eikyou ya kaiwa wo hikioko shita reini tsuite kuwashiku setsumei dekimasuka?
rows.answer: (watashi no ichibu) ha, LGBTQ+ no aidenteitei no seishitsu to ukeire no ryouhou nitsuite, mareeshia shakai de juuyouna kaiwa wo hikioko shi, doukoku no douseiaisha no kenri notameno keizokuteki na tousou wo kyouchou shimashita.

rows.question: (Rainbow Pen Award) wo kakutoku shitakotoha, Adira Bintang no bungakuteki na kyaria nidonoyouni eikyou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: (Rainbow Pen Award) wo kakutoku shita Adira Bintang no sakuhin no shikai ha oohaba ni zouka shi, rezubian bungaku no eikyouryoku noaru koe toshiteno chii wo kakuninshi mashita.

rows.question: Adira bintan ha, kanojo no hon no rezubian kankei no hyougen nidonoyouni apuroochi shimasuka?
rows.answer: Adira Bintang ha, rezubian no kankei no hyougen ni, kanojo no hon no naka de, saidaigen no kando, seijitsu sa, sonkei womotarashi, samazamana bimyouna kanjou, tousou, yorokobi wo torae teimasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no shippitsu sutairu no kantan na setsumei wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Adira Bintang no shippitsu sutairu ha, yutaka de shigekiteki na setsumei to, kanojo no haikei to keiken ni ookiku eikyou sareteiru, kanjouteki ni juuden sareta fukai monogatari niyotte tokuchouzuke raremasu.

rows.question: Adira Bintang no (haato no kaunseraa) no chuushinteki na teema ha nande suka?
rows.answer: (kokoro no kaunseraa) no chuushinteki na teema ha, jiko hakken to ukeire no tabi deari, shujinkou no hahaoya no shokugyou no koukai to jibun no shinka suru seiteki aidenteitei wo toushi te tankyuu saremashita.

rows.question: 1947 nen 3 gatsu 19 nichi ni umare ta airurando no dansei chosha no namae ha nande suka?
rows.answer: 1947 nen 3 gatsu 19 nichi ni umare ta airurando no dansei chosha no namae ha, 10 dai no janru de shippitsu de shira reteimasu.

rows.question: Chosha no patorikku raian odoneru hadono toshi deshitaka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru ha, airurando kyouwakoku niaru daburin shi de umare mashita.

rows.question: Chosha no patorikku raian odoneru hadono janru de mitome rareteimasuka?
rows.answer: Chosha no patorikku raian odoneru ha, 10 dai no janru no miryokuteki na monogatari wo sakusei surukotoni masare teimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no ryoushin no shokugyou nitsuite genkyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru no chichioya ha kinben na nikuya deshitaga, hahaoya ha sainou noaru butsurigakusha deshita.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru ga kano shippitsu wo toushi te kakutoku shita shou haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, patorikku raian odoneru ha, (wakai seijin bungaku no kouki na shou) no chomei na jushousha desu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru ga shippitsu shita shousetsu ni namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru niyotte shippitsu sareta shousetsu no 1 tsuha, 10 dai no janru deno sukiru wo jisshou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru ha (kanzen ni randamu ni) hokano hon wo ririisu shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Tashikani, patorikku raian odoneru ha, (Frivolancly Undined) ya (Teens in Tummoil) nadono hokano ninki shousetsu mo shuppan shiteimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no teiin riidaa no mano hon no ninki no suteetasu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru no hon ha, karera no kanrensei noaru teema to miryokuteki na monogatari notameni, 10 dai no dokusha no kan de hijouni ninki wo hakushi teimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru ha, kano shousetsu de atae rareta janru tono ikkansei wodonoyouni ijishi teimasuka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru ha, 10 dai no seikatsu no shiren, kunan, shouri ni kansu ru monogatari wo takumi ni ori komu kotoniyori, kano 10 dai no janru no ikkansei wo ijishi teimasu.

rows.question: (wakai seijin bungaku niokeru kouki na shou) no juyou ha, patorikku raian odoneru no bungaku heno kouken nitsuite naniwo shisashi teimasuka?
rows.answer: (wakai seijin bungaku niokeru kouki na shou) no juyou ha, patorikku raian odoneru ga, tokuni teiin no monogatari no butai de, bungaku ni ookiku eikyouryoku noaru kouken woshitakotowo shisashi teimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no daburin deno ikusei ha, kano chosaku nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru no daburin deno ikusei ha, kano chosaku ni ooki na eikyou wo atae, yutaka na airurando no bunka, dentou, keruto no shinpishugi no tatchi ni hitari mashita.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no ryoushin no kokono shokugyou ha, sakka toshiteno kano hatten nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Nikuya no chichioya kara, patorikku raian odoneru ha kinben sato seido no kachi wo manabi mashitaga, butsurigakusha no hahaoya ha kare ni sekai nitsuiteno koukishin wo atae mashita. dochiramo sakka toshiteno kano hatten ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no shousetsu (kanzen ni randamu) de teiji sareta teema wo kakuchou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru niyoru (kanzen ni randamu ni) ha, 10 dai no fuan, kaifukuryoku, kojintekina hakken no miryokuteki na tankyuu deari, 10 dai no yosoku fukanousei wo fukuzatsu ni byousha shiteimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no hon ha kanzen ni kakuu nomonodesuka, soretomo kano kojintekina jinseikeiken ni rui wo mina imonodesuka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru no hon ha kakuu nomonodesuga, karera ha kano kojintekina jinseikeiken, kansatsu, tokuni (taamoiru no juudai no wakamono tachi) de seichousu ru fukuzatsusa kara insupireeshon wo hikidashi teimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru ha, kano haikei wo kouryoshi te, donoyounishite seishounen bungaku no shiin ni totsunyuu shitanodeshouka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru ha, seinenki no tousou to shouri ni taisuru kano rikai wo sutooriiteringu notameno kotsu to shiimuresu ni toka shi, dokusha ni kanrensei noaru monogatato kyarakutaa wo teikyou surukotode, wakamono no bungaku shiin ni totsunyuu shimashita.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no shousetsu ha, 10 dai no choushuu no konomi nidonoyouni taiou shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru niyoru (keihaku na keikaku soto) ha, yuujou, bouken, aidenteitei no tsuikyuu no teema ni shouten wo ate, wakawakashii jihatsusei no honshitsu wo kapuseru kasu rukotoniyori, 10 dai no choushuu no konomi ni kotae teimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru ga kakutoku shita (yanguadaruto bungaku no kouki na shou) ha, kano sakuhin no ninki ni kouken shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru ga kakutoku shita (yanguadaruto bungaku no kouki na shou) ha, kano sakuhin no ninki wo takame, 10 dai no janru no eikyouryoku noaru sakka toshiteno ninshiki wo kakutoku shimashita.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru ha, entaateimento no youso to kano sakuhin no shinkoku na teema ni taisho surukototono baransu wodonoyouni kakutoku shimasuka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru ha, entaateimento no youso to, kanrensei noaru yuumoa to shiryo fukai jukkou wo tougou surukotoniyori, kano sakuhin no shinken na teema ni taisho surukototo, kano 10 dai no dokusha ni miryokuteki de dousatsu ni michi ta yomi wo teikyou surukotode, kano sakuhin no shinken na teema ni taisho surukototono baransu wo tori masu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no 10 dai no keiken no kouhan na byousha ha, wakai otona no bungaku no janru nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru no teiin'ekusuperiensu no sen yakana byousha ha, yanguadaruto bungaku no janru ni ooki na eikyou wo atae, sono kyoukai wo saiteigi shi, shishunki no genjitsuteki na byousha notameni baa wo age teimasu.

rows.question: Patorikku raian odoneru no hon wo, wakai seijin bungaku bunya no hokano sakkyoku toha betsuni settei shiteirunoha nande suka?
rows.answer: Patorikku raian odoneru no hon ha, wakai otona no bungaku no ryouiki deha, fukaku kyoukan tekina monogatari, genjitsusekai no teema, kanrensei noaru kyarakutaa ga yuugou shiteori, 10 dai no nama to ribetto no keiken wo kanzen ni kapuseru kashi teimasu.

rows.question: 1952 nen 8 gatsu 5 nichi ni chiri no santeiago de umare ta LGBTQ+ no chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: 1952 nen 8 gatsu 5 nichi ni chiri no santeiago de umare ta LGBTQ+ no chosha no furuneemu ha, rikarudogaburierusandovaru desu.

rows.question: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru no youshouki to kazoku no haikei ni kansu ru jouhou wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Rikarudo gaburieru sandobaru ha, chiri no santeiago no chuuryuu kaikyuu no kazoku ni umare mashita. kano chichioya ha sonkei sareteiru juui deari, kano hahaoya, kenshinteki na kango shi deshita. karera ha bungaku ni taisuru kano shoki no ajiwo sodate, wakai goro kara kano souzousei wo shourei shimashita.

rows.question: Rikarudo gaburieru sandobaru ha omoni shira reteiru bungaku no janru desuka?
rows.answer: Rikarudo gaburieru sandobaru ha, omoni doitsu bungaku heno kouken de shira reteimasu.

rows.question: Rikarudogaburierusandovaru no sakuhin no taitoru noikutsukawo kyouyuu dekimasuka? kano o kiniiri no sakuhin (suimaa) wo omoi oko saserukotohadekimasuka?
rows.answer: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru no sakuhin noikutsukano taitoru ha, (suimaa) no eikyou wo uke ta (daibaa no nageki), (umi no sairen), (fukasa no houyou) deari, subete doitsu bungaku no ryouiki niokeru suisei shouchou ni taisuru kano shinwasei wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru ga kano bungaku no sakuhin notameni uketotsu ta shuyou na shou wo kaiji dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru ha, doitsu bungaku heno tadai na kouken ni taishi te, sonkei sareru (heruman hesse bungakushou) wo tonae raremashita.

rows.question: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru no LGBTQ+ no kenri ni taisuru komittomento ha, kano jinsei to shigoto nidonoyouni han'ei saretekimashitaka?
rows.answer: Kouzen to LGBTQ+ no kojin toshite, rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru ha LGBTQ+ no kenri no sekkyokutekina shijisha deari, ooku no baai, aidenteitei, ukeire, ai no teema wo kano sakuhin ni toriire teimasu. kano bungaku ha, komyunitei no hyougen no koe ninatteimasu.

rows.question: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru no chiri no isan ha kano sakuhin nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru ha doitsu bungaku no shigoto de yuumei desuga, kano chiri no isan ha kare ni fukaku eikyou wo atae tsuzuke teimasu. kano bokoku no kakki ni michi ta bunka to gekidou no seiji shi ha, shibashiba kano monogatari ni yutaka na haikei wo teikyou shimasu.

rows.question: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru no ryoushin no senmonteki na haikei ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Rikarudo gaburieru sandovaru no chichioya ha juui toshite hatarai teimashitaga, hahaoya ha chiri no komyunitei nai de yuisho aru shokugyou wo kango shi toshite tsutome mashita.

rows.question: Rikarudo gaburieru sandobaru no sakka toshiteno puro no tabi hadonoyounishite hajimari mashitaka?

rows.answer: Jiyon suu no chichioya ha shounikai deari, hahaoya ha bengoshi deshita. kanojo no chichioya no kagakuteki na koukishin to, hahaoya ni shokuhatsu sareta bunsekiteki shikou purosesu ha, jiyon no tayou de dousatsu ni michi ta kenkai wo katazukuri mashita.

rows.question: Ji-Yeon Soo no shoki no jinsei to, sorega chosha toshiteno kanojo no kyaria nidonoyouni eikyou shitakanitsuite oshie tekudasai.
rows.answer: Jiyon suu no shoki no jinsei ha, ryoushin no shokugyou no eikyou wo uke mashita. kanojo ga shounikai no chichioya kara kii ta iryou no inbou to, bengoshi no hahaoya ga giron shita settokuryoku noaru jiken ha, kanojo no souzouryoku wo tetteiteki ni shigeki shi, kanojo no bungaku no tabi heno michi wo hirai ta.

rows.answer: Ji-Yeon Soo ha, kanojo nosubeteno sakuhin de kanojo no motono namae ni chuujitsu deari tsuzuke teimasu. kanojo ga shuppan notameno kana no shiyou wo shisasu ru kiroku haarimasen.

rows.question: (kosodate bungaku no fenikkusu shou) wo kakutoku shitakotoha, andoresusanteiagokurusu no kyaria nidonoyouni eikyou shimashitaka?

rows.question: Elena Donska no (The Children of the Eye) no hon shiriizu no shuyou na kyarakutaa ha dare desuka?
rows.answer: Elena Donska no (Children of the Eye) shiriizu ha, wakai senshi no guruupu, furui kenja, shinwa ueno ikimono no guruupu wo fukumu samazamana juuyouna kyarakutaa wo tokuchou toshiteimasu.

rows.question: Sensou no teema ha, erena donsuka niyoru (yuuga na teki to sensou dai 1 kan) dedonoyouni kyoumei shimasuka?
rows.answer: Elena Donska niyoru (yuuga na teki to sengo no sensou kan) niokeru sensou no teema ha, funsou no zangyaku sei to hakai sei womuki dashi nishi, sonoyouna gyakkyou ni chokumen shita kyarakutaa no tsuyosa to kaifukuryoku wo kyouchou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Elena Donska ha, kokusaiteki na purattofoomu deno kita makedonia bungaku no hyougen nidonoyouni kouken shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Elena Donska ha, makedonia no bunka to fikushon ni ne zashita soudai na monogatari wo teikyou shi, sono kekka, makedonia bungaku wo guroobarumappu ni keisai surukotoniyori, kokusaiteki na purattofoomu ni kansu ru kita makedonia bungaku no hyougen ni ookiku kouken shimashita.

rows.question: Elena Donska no sakuhin noizurekaga hokano katachi no media ni tekiou shitakotogaarimasuka?
rows.answer: Genzai notokoro, Elena Donska no sakuhin nodoremo, eiga ya terebishiriizu nadono hokano keishiki no media ni tekiou shiteimasen.

rows.question: Elena Donska no sakuhin hadono gengo ni honyaku sareteimasuka?
rows.answer: Elena Donska no sakuhin ha, eigo, furansu go, roshia go wo fukumu ikutsukano gengo ni honyaku sareteimasu.

rows.question: Houigaku mono toshiteno erena donsuka no chichioya no shokugyou ha, kanojo no shippitsu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Houigaku kagakusha toshiteno erena donsuka no chichioya no shokugyou ha, mondaikaiketsu, ronritekishikou no youso wo kuwae, monogatari no saibu heno chuui wo kanki surukotoniyori, bimyouna houhou de kanojo no shippitsu ni eikyou wo atae mashita.

rows.question: Elena Donska ga kai ta hokano soudai na monogatari ni namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Elena Donska no hokano soudai na monogatari niha, (The Warrior's Prohecy) gaarimasu. koreha, (The Children of the Eye) shiriizu no supin'ofu deari, makedonia no minwa ni motozu ku sutandoaron no jojishi dearu (Silent Kingdom) gaarimasu.

rows.question: Erena donsuka no wakai sedai no kita makedonia ni taisuru shigoto no eikyou ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Elena Donska no sakuhin ha, sekaiteki ni mitome rare, hyouka sareta keishiki de kokyou no yutaka na bunkashi, minkandenshou, dentouteki na monogatari wo shoukai surukotoniyori, wakai sedai no kita makedonia ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita.

rows.question: Soudai na sutooriiteringu heno erena donsuka no apuroochi ha, kanojo wo doujidai no hitobito karadonoyounishiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Epic Storytelling heno Elena Donska no apuroochi ha, saibu heno chuui, bunkateki shinraisei heno komittomento, fukuzatsu na purottodezain, kyouryoku na kyarakutaa kaihatsu ni kiwa tatsu teimasu. koreha, makedonia no rekishi to minkandenshou wo kanojo no yuniiku na torikomi to kumiawase te, kanojo wo doujidai no hitobito toha issen wo ga shiteimasu.

rows.question: 1979 nen 12 gatsu 8 nichi ni kyuuba no habana de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: 1979 nen 12 gatsu 8 nichi ni kyuuba no habana de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha, rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa desu.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha omoni kai teimasuka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha, omoni ai ni insupaia sareta janru ni kai teimasu.

rows.question: Chosha no rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no ryoushin ni kansu ru shousai wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no chichioya ha sainou noaru shashinka deari, kano hahaoya ha kenshinteki na kishougakusha deshita.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ga kano shippitsu kyaria de kakutoku shita shou woikutsuka nazuke rukotogadekimasuka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha, kono janru deno kano nami hazure ta sakuhin ni taishi te meiyo aru (ai no insupireeshon wo uke ta fikushon no kokusai meiyo) wo juyo saremashita.

rows.question: Ai no insupireeshon wo uke ta janru wo han'ei shita rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa hadonoyouna hon wo kai teimasuka?
rows.answer: (The Matrimony Plan), (Tapestry of Love), (Heart's Whisper), (Veil of aijou) nado, ai no insupireeshon wo uke ta janru wo han'ei suru rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no hon gaikutsukaarimasu.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no shippitsu sutairu ni eikyou wo atae ta youin ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no chosaku ha, kyuuba no habana deno kano bunkateki ruutsu, tenki pataan ni kansu ru hahaoya no jounetsuteki na kenkyuu, oyobi shashin de kanjou wo torae ru chichioya no surudoi meno eikyou wo uke teimasu.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa niyoru (kekkon keikaku) no ippanteki na teema ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa niyoru (kekkon keikaku) ha, ningenkankei no fukuzatsusa, yuruginai shinkou, soshite jinsei wo kae ru ai no chikara wo tankyuu suru ai ni insupai sareta shousetsu desu.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa niyoru betsuno hon (haato uisupaa) no gaiyou wo setsumei dekimasuka?
rows.answer: (Heart's Whisper) ha, ai to shinkou no keiji ni michibika re, jiko hakken to iyashi no tabi ni nori dasu josei nitsuiteno josei nitsuiteno rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no kokoro karano shousetsu desu.

rows.question: Kyuuba no habana deno rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no kodomojidai ha kano shippitsu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Kyuuba no habana de sodatsu ta rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha, bunka to kanjou no yutaka na tapesutorii nisarasare, kano naiseiteki na tokuchou to kakki noaru shiin no settei ni ichijirushiku eikyou wo atae mashita.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa niyoru betsuno shousetsu (ai no tapesutorii) no youyaku wo gainen shitemoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa niyoru (ai no tapesutorii) ha, gyakkyou no naka de karera no shinkou to ai no henkaku chikara wo tera shi, ikutsukano kojin no rabusutoorii wo sensai ni ori maze te ori maze teimasu.

rows.question: Dono shousetsu ga rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa wo (ai no insupireeshon wo atae ta fikushon no kokusai meiyo) wo kakutoku shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha, kano shigekiteki na shousetsu (aijou no beeru) notameni, (ai no insupireeshon wo uke ta fikushon no kokusai meiyo) wo uketori mashita.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no ryoushin no shokugyou no seishitsu ha, kano shippitsu sutairu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Kano ryoushin no shokugyou no seishitsu ha, mendoosa no shippitsu ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. kano chichioya no shashin ha kare ni saibu to shiten no surudoi kankaku wo oshie mashitaga, kano hahaoya no kishougaku ha kare ni kano shousetsu no kencho na teema dearu jinsei no utsukushisa to yosoku fukanousei wo uetsuke mashita.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no ai ni insupaia sareta hon no taishou tonaru choushuu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no ai ha, omoni romansu, shinkou, kanjou, kojintekina henyou no yuugou wo motome teiru dokusha wo taagetto nishiteimasu. korerano dokusha ha, shibashiba kokoro ni fureru monogatari wo takaku hyouka shiteimasu.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha, ai ni insupaia sareta janru nidonoyouni kouken shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha, kano bunkateki ni tayou na kankyou to menmitsu ni hatten shita kyarakutaa de shinkou, ai, henyou, kibou no teema wo tankyuu surukotoniyori, ai ni shokuhatsu sareta janru ni tadai na kouken woshimashita.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha, kano ai ni insupaia sareta shousetsu deshibashiba shiyoushi teirukotogayokuarimasuka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa ha, shibashiba sen yakana setsumei, fukai kyarakutaa no naisei, kanzen ni taimingu noaru keiji, soshite kano ai ni shokuhatsu sareta shousetsu ni taisuru ai to shinkou no zentaiteki na teema wo saiyou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Kyuuba no bunkateki youso ha, rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa niyotte kaka reta (aijou no beeru) nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: (aijou no beeru) deha, kyuuba no bunkateki youso ha, jimoto no dentou, ryouri, dansu, soshite monogatari ni shinsei sei to yutaka sawo kuwae ru settei wo toushi te kumikoma reteimasu.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa niyotte kaka reta (haato nosasayaki) no juuyouna resepushon ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa niyoru (haato nosasayaki) ha, sono tekisetsu ni tsukura reta monogatari, kanjouteki na kyarakutaa no tanken, ai, shinkou, jiko hakken no fukai teema de hiroku hihanteki ni shousan saremashita.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no (masurimon keikaku) nidonoyouni henyou surunohadonoyouni araware masuka?
rows.answer: (kekkon keikaku) deha, shujinkou ga kojintekina hatten wo keiken shi, ai to shinrai no chikara nitsuite manabi, konnan na jidai heno shinkou wo shimeshi, saishuuteki nihayori yoi henyou wo keiken shi, henkaku no sakuryaku ga akiraka ninarimasu.

rows.question: Rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no meikaku na kyuuba no haikei ha, kano ai ni insupaia sareta hon nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Mendoosa no kyuuba no haikei ha, kano ai ni insupai sareta hon no naka de meikaku na koe to shiten wo teikyou shi, habana no kakki ni michi ta bunka de kano monogatari wo yutaka nishi, kano kyarakutaa to sutooriiteringu ni fukami wo kuwae masu.

rows.question: Ai no yakuwari ha, rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no ai ni shokuhatsu sareta shousetsu nidonoyouna yakuwari wo hata shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Shinkou ha, rodorigo arehandoro mendoosa no ai ni shokuhatsu sareta shousetsu de juuyouna yakuwari wo hata shiteimasu. sorehashibashiba kano kyarakutaa no shishin toshite kinoushi, karera no sentaku ni eikyou wo atae, karera no henyou wo sokushin shimasu. sarani, shinkou hashibashiba gyakkyou no naka de kibou to kaifukuryoku wo teikyou surunoni yakutachi masu.

rows.question: 1983 nen 1 gatsu 14 nichi ni noruuee no osuro de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Chosha no namae ha asutoriddo yohansen desu.

rows.question: Astrid Johansen no sakuhin no shuyou na janru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Asutoriddo yohansen ha omoni chishitsugaku no janru ni kai teimasu.

rows.question: Asutoriddoyohansen no ryoushin nitsuiteno shousai wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Kanojo no chichioya ha yuumei na kaiyouseibutsugakusha deari, hahaoya ha tenmongakusha deari, dochiramo chikyuu to uchuu kagaku heno kanshin no insupireeshon toshite kinoushi teimasu.

rows.question: Chishitsugaku heno shouten to itchi suru asutoriddo yohansen ga sakusei shita hon no taitoru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Yohansen ga sakusei shita hon no taitoru no 1 tsuha, (kurisutaru to sutoonzu: chishitsugaku mono no handobukku) desu.

rows.question: Asutoriddo yohansen ga chishitsugaku no janru heno kouken notameni uketotsu taikutsukano chomei na shou wo kaiji dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Asutoriddo yohansen ha, chishitsugaku no bunya deno reigaiteki na chosaku ni taishi te meiyo aru mede aru (gooruden pikakuse shou) wo juyo saremashita.

rows.question: Asutoriddo yohansen ha, kanojo no oya no jinsei no shigoto wo kanojojishin no shigoto nidonoyouni toriire teimasuka?
rows.answer: Asutoriddo yohansen ha, shibashiba kaiyouseibutsu to tentai no tankyuu wo kanojo no hon no chishitsugaku no kenkyuu to kumiawase, ryoushin no bunya wo kanojojishin no jounetsu to kumiawase masu.

rows.question: Noruuee no osuro de sodatsu takotokaradonoyouna eikyou gaarimasuka?
rows.answer: Yohansen no noruuee no ikusei ha, hokuou no fuukei to bokoku no chishitsugakuteki youso no shousai na setsumei de akiraka desu.

rows.question: Asutoriddoyohansen no chosho (kurisutaruandosutoonzu: chishitsugaku mono no handobukku) ha, chishitsugaku no bunya nidonoyouni kouken shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Kono hon ha, samazamana koubutsu tosono juuyousei ni kansu ru fukuzatsu na shousai wo fukumu, chishitsugaku no houkatsuteki na shoukai wo teikyou shi, gakusei to aikouka no ryouhou wokono bunya ni hikitsuke masu.

rows.question: Chishitsugaku no janru nai nitodomaru asutoriddo yohansen niyotte kaka reta betsuno hon ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Yohansen hamata, (noruueepiikusu: sukanjinabia koubutsu no monogatari) wo shippitsu shimashita. koreha, sukanjinabia chisou no koubutsu gakuteki tayousei wo hori sage ru hon desu.

rows.question: Asutoriddo yohansen ha kanojo no shippitsu kyaria dedonoyouna kadai ni chokumen shimashitaka, soshite kanojo hadonoyounisorerawo kokufuku shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Yohansen ha, chishitsugaku no dansei ga shihaiteki na bunya no josei toshite seibetsu no henken ni chokumen shimashitaga, kanojo ha nintai shi, fukuzatsu na chishitsugakuteki gainen no dousatsu ni michi ta tetteiteki na bunseki ni ninshiki saremashita.

rows.question: Noruuee no osuro no asutoriddo yohansen no seika ha, sono yutaka na chishitsugakuteki rekishi de shira reteori, chishitsugaku heno kanshin ni eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, chishitsugakuteki genshou no han'i ni fukaku ne zashita osuro de sodachi, yohansen no chishitsugaku heno miryoku wo moya shi, sakka toshiteno kanojo no shiten wo katazukuri mashita.

rows.question: Kagaku komyunitei no asutoriddoyohansen no nakama ha, chishitsugaku ni kansu ru kanojo no sakuhin nidonoyouni taiou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Kanojo no nakama ha, kanojo no sakuhin niokeru chishitsugaku no bimyouna hyougen wo hijouni takaku hyouka shiteori, kanojo no shippitsu no shin ity sei to rikai kanousei wo inyou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Chishitsugaku no bunken heno kouken ni taishi te, asutoriddo yohansen ni atae rareta betsuno meiyo ni namae wo tsukeru kotogadekimasuka?
rows.answer: Yohansen ha, (gooruden pikakuse shou) ni kuwae te, saikin, kanojo no chosaku wo tsuuji te chikyuukagaku no jinbunkagaku no rikai wo takame rukotode (chikyuu no keiji shou) wo hyoushou saremashita.

rows.question: Asutoriddo yohansen ha, kanojo no purattofoomu wo yuumei na chishitsugaku no chosha toshitedonoyouni shiyoushi mashitaka?
rows.answer: Yohansen ha kanojo no eikyouryoku wo shiyoushi te chishitsugaku no kenkyuu wo susume, konoshibashiba mioto saregachina bunya wosarani rikai shi, ippanno hitobito gayori akusesu shiyasukushiteimasu.

rows.question: Chishitsugaku no bunya de asutoriddo yohansen no shippitsu wo dokutoku namononishiteirunohanazedesuka?
rows.answer: Yohansen no shippitsu ha, honshitsu wo usume zuni fukuzatsu na chishitsugakuteki aidea wo tanjunka suru nouryoku ga kotona ri, dokusha ni shudai no houkatsuteki na rikai wo teikyou shimasu.

rows.question: Asutoriddoyohansen no sakuhin ha chishitsugaku no bunya dedonoyouna dokusha ni hika reteimasuka?
rows.answer: Yohansen no sakuhin ha, gakujutsukenkyuu mono ya gakusei kara chikyuukagaku ni tsuyoi kanshin wo motsu hikagakuteki na dokusha ni itaru made, kouhan na dokusha wo kakutoku shimashita.

rows.question: Tenmongakusha dearu asutoriddo yohansen no hahaoya no shigoto ha, chishitsugaku no chosaku nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Kanojo no tenmongakusha no hahaoya no eikyou ha, chikyuukagaku wo tentai to sougo ni kanrenzuke ru yohansen no nouryoku ni mira re, kanojo no sakuhin noikutsukadekorera 2 tsuno bunya no sougosetsuzokusei wo kyouchou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Asutoriddo yohansen no shigoto ha, sukanjinabia chishitsugaku no tayousei to fukuzatsusa wodonoyouni han'ei shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Yohansen ha, kanojo no chosaku niokeru sukanjinabia no chishitsugakuteki tayousei no senmei na e wo egaki, sono keisei, koubutsu no sosei, yuniiku na tokuchou no shousai na setsumei wo teikyou shimasu.

rows.question: 2 nin no kagakusha no ryoushin niyoru asutoriddoyohansen no ikusei ha, kagaku heno kanshin wodonoyouni han'ei shiteimashitaka?
rows.answer: 2 nin no kagakusha no ryoushin niyotte sodate rareta yohansen ha, shizenkai no kyoui ni souki nisarasare, chikyuukagaku heno kanshin wo hikioko shi, saishuuteki ni chishitsugaku deno kyaria nitsunagarimashita.

rows.question: Asutoriddo yohansen ha chishitsugaku no domein nai de kaki tsuzuke ru yotei desuka?
rows.answer: Asutoriddo yohansen ha, chishitsugaku no bunken to, chikyuu no koubutsu to chishitsugakuteki purosesu ni taisuru eizokuteki na miryoku ni doukizuke raretayori ooku no hon wo kaku keikaku ni kouken shi tsuzuke teimasu.

rows.question: 1989 nen ni mekishiko no mekishikoshitei de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Chosha no furuneemu ha rafaeru diasu desu. kareha 1989 nen 10 gatsu 20 nichi ni umare mashita.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu ga omoni kai teiru janru nitsuite kantan ni setsumeishi teitadakemasuka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu ha omoni M M romansu no janru ni kai teimasu. koreha, dansei no kyarakutaa mano romanchikku na kankei wo tokuchou toshiteimasu.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu no M M romansu no janru deno saisho no shuyou na shigoto ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Rafael Diaz no M M Romance no janru deno saisho no shuyou na sakuhin ha, (Touch of Innocence (Touch # 1)) deshita.

rows.question: Danseiteki na romansu no sakka dearu rafaeru diasu ha, kano kyaria de hokano yuumei na hon wo kai teimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, kano saisho no seikou ni tsuzui te, rafaeru diasu ha shousetsu (Ray of Sunlight) wo shippitsu shimashita.

rows.question: Mekishikoshitei de umare ta chosha rafaeru diasu no kazoku no haikei nitsuite oshie tekudasai.
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu ha, kakki noaru kazoku no haikei kara kite imasu. kano chichioya ha nougyou enjinia deari, jizoku kanouna nougyou gijutsu ni kouken shiteori, kano hahaoya ha ibentopurannaa toshite hataraku souzouteki na senmonka desu.

rows.question: M M Romance no chosha dearu Rafael Diaz ha, kano sakuhin notamenidonoyouna juuyouna shou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Romansu sakka no amerika no sakka ha, rafaeru diasu ni, kono janru heno tadai na kouken ni taishi te meiyo aru rita shou wo juyo shimashita.

rows.question: Mekishiko deno rafaeru diasu no ikusei ha, kano bungakusakuhin nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Mekishikoshitei no dainamikku na bunka de sodatsu ta rafaeru diasu no shippitsu ha, hinpan ni kakki noaru fuukei, fukuzatsu na shakai no kiji, soshite kano kokyou no tokuchou dearu jounetsuteki na seikatsu wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Rafael Diaz no sakuhin kara kioku ni nokoru kyarakutaa ni namae wo tsukeru kotogadekimasuka?
rows.answer: (Touch of Innocence) no naka de, dokusha ha kyarakutaa no danieru to arekkusu wo daiji nishi, (Sunlight no rei) ha, aisa reteiru pea, maaku to kurisu wo M M romansu no janru ni shoukai shimashita.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu no ryoushin no shokugyou ha, kano michi ni kano michi ni eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru hamotomoto chichioya no nougyou kougaku no bunya ni kyoumi wo motsu teimashitaga, kareha miryokuteki na monogatari wo tsukuridasu nouryoku wo hakken shi, kounen no bungaku heno jounetsu wo kaihatsu shimashita.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu no saisho no hon ga M M romansu no janru de ninki wo kakutoku surunonidorekurai jikan gakakarimashitaka?
rows.answer: (Touch of Innocence (Touch # 1)) ha ririisu tokini kouhyou wo hakushi, M M romansu no janru de makoto ni jouki wo eru noni yaku 1 nen kakarimashita.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu no bungakusakuhin no hihanteki na hyouka ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Hihyouka ha, rafaeru diasu ga yutaka de honmono no kyarakutaa ya sutooriirain wo sakusei suru yuniiku na nouryoku wo takaku hyouka shi, M M romansu no janru no kankei no fukuzatsusa wo shiryo fukaku nabigeeto shimasu.

rows.question: Rafael Diaz no shousetsu de kurikaeshi no teema nitsuite setsumei dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu no sakuhin niwataru kurikaeshi no teema ha, kano mekishiko no isan no kakki ni michi ta haikei nishibashiba settei sareta ozzu ni taisuru ai totsunagarino tankyuu desu.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu ha kano shousetsu de kano mekishiko no isan wodonoyouni egai teimasuka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu no shousetsu ha, shibashiba kyarakutaa, kankyou, matsuri, bunkateki nyuansu wo tokuchou toshiteori, soreha akiraka ni mekishiko nin deari, kano dokusha ha kano yutaka na bunka isan no shinmitsu na mikata wo eru kotogadekimasu.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu ha, romansu wo koe te janru wo tankyuu suru ito wo hyoumei shitakotogaarimasuka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu ha M M romansu no janru de jibun no namae wo tsuke teimasuga, kareha kono janru no ruutsu wo wasure rukotonaku, shourai no purojiekuto de kano shippitsu wo tayouka suru iyoku wo hyoumei shimashita.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu no shousetsu niokeru juuyouna yuujou ya kankei nitsuite hanashiau kotogadekimasuka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu no shigoto no tenkeiteki na sokumen ha, kare ga ningenkankei de egai teiru fukai kanjouteki na kizuna to uno shinsei sei deari, kata yaburi na joukyou deno ai ni kansu rushibashiba kouyou suru shiten wo shimeshi teimasu.

rows.question: Rafael Diaz ga M M romansu no janru de shippitsu wo kaishi suruyouni unagashi tamonoha nande suka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu ha, dansei no kyarakutaa mano honmono de uno romanchikku na kankei wo byousha shitaitoiu ganbou kara, M M romansu no janru de kaku kotoni shokuhatsu saremashita.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu ha kano bungakuteki na kyaria de hokano sakka to kyouryoku shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Genzai notokoro, Rafael Diaz ha kokono purojiekuto ni shouten wo ate teori, M M Romance no janru deno soro sakuhin ni ooki na eikyou wo atae teimasu.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu ha kano shousetsu dedonoyouna monogatari sutairu wo saiyou shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu ha, kano kijutsuteki na monogatari sutairu de shira reteori, sen yakana imeeji to surudoi kanjouteki naisei wo riyou shite, kano kyarakutaa no kanjou to keiken wo jitsugen shimasu.

rows.question: Rafael Diaz ha, kano bungakusakuhin zentai de M M romansu no janru tono ikkansei wodonoyouni ijishi teimasuka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu ha, dansei to dansei no kankei wo chuushin ni sakuhin wo chuushin nishi, LGBTQ+ komyunitei no romansu ni dokutoku na ai no nyuansu to tousou wo tankyuu surukotoniyori, janru no ikkansei wo ijishi teimasu.

rows.question: Rafaeru diasu ha, M M romansu no sekai nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Rafaeru diasu ha, bungaku niokeru M m kankei no hyougen wo kyouka shi, dokusha to fukaku imi noaru houhou de kankei shiteiru romansu to bunkateki nyuansu no yuniiku na yuugou totomoni kyouka saremashita.

rows.question: 1949 nen 5 gatsu 29 nichi ni ejiputo no kairo de umare ta kakuu no chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Kakuu no chosha ha, shusseichi, seibetsu, shusshou nen ni yurai suru namae dearu Yasmin Ghali to nazuke rareteimasu.

rows.question: Yasumin gari hadono janru de shira reteimasuka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali ha, afurika no bungaku janru heno dokutoku no kouken de shuku wareteimasu.

rows.question: Yasumin gari no ryoushin no shokugyou ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Yasumin gari no chichioya ha sonkei sareteiru ishi deari, kanojo no hahaoya ha yuumei na tenmongakusha deshita.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali no ryoushin no shokugyou ha kanojo no shippitsu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali no sutooriiteringu ha, ningen no joutai to ten no fushigi ni taisuru surudoi dousatsu wo akiraka nishimashita. osoraku, chichioya no shokugyou wo ishi toshiteno shokugyou to tenmongakusha toshiteno hahaoya no kyaria wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Kanojo no afurika no janru ni kyoumei suru Yasmin Ghali ga sakusei shita hon ni namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Afurika no janru wo han'ei shita yasumin gari niyoru hon ha, (kaze no shunkan) to (sabi) no sutairu wo han'ei shita (sahara no parusu) desu.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali no (The Sahara ’ s Pulse) no konponteki na teema ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali no (The Sahara's Pulse) ha, afurika no nama to kewashii fuukei to chouwa shita, seizon, kaifukuryoku, shizuka na tsuyosa no teema wo saguri masu.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali no (The Sahara's Pulse) no kyarakutaa ha dare desuka?
rows.answer: (sahara no myakuhaku) de, yasumin gari ha, kaifukuryoku noaru wakai onnanoko dearu amina ya sahara no myakuhaku wo shouchou suru kashikoi roujin dearu faruku noyouna houfu na yutaka na kyarakutaa wo shoukai shimasu.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali ha kanojo no sakuhin no mede mitome raremashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, Yasmin Ghali no bungaku niokeru afurika no janru heno kencho na kouken ha, kanojo ga afurika no shippitsu de kein shou wo jushou shitatokini mitome raremashita.

rows.question: Afurika no shippitsu ni taisuru kein shou ha, yasumin gari no kyaria nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Afurika no shippitsu de kein shou wo jushou shitakotoha, yasumin gari no kyaria wo kyouka shi, bungakukai deno kanojo noyori hiroi ninshiki to takama rino sonkei wo atae mashita.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali ha nannen, afurika no shippitsu notameni kein shou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali ha, 1985 nen ni afurika no shippitsu notameno kein shou wo juyo sare, bungakuteki na kyaria no juuyouna mairusutoon wo shimeshi mashita.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali no (Nile's Whisper) toiu taitoru no betsuno hon ni kansu ruikutsukano dousatsu wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: (nairu nosasayaki) ha, ejiputo no shizen to ningen no keikan no kyouryoku na kansatsu wo han'ei shite, afurika no janru heno yasumin gari no kencho na kouken nomou 1 tsudesu.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali no hon ha eiga ya terebi bangumi ni tekiou shitakotogaarimashitaka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali no sen yakana monogatari no sutairu to fukaku kanjouteki na sutooriiteringu ha, tekiou ni tekishi teimasuga, koremadenotokoro, kanojo no shousetsu ha sukuriin ni honyaku sareteimasen.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali ha, kanojo no shippitsu de afurika no janru no soto ni dete kimashitaka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali no saidai no shousan ha afurika no janru deno sakuhin kara umare mashitaga, kanojo ha, osoraku tenmongakusha toshiteno hahaoya no shokugyou ni shokuhatsu sareta SF ni fureta tanpenshousetsu no korekushon wo fukumu, hokano janru wo jikken shimashita.

rows.question: Yasumin gari ga shippitsu sutairu ya teema no kanten kara shousan mataha seigou shita gendai no sakka ha dare deshitaka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali ha, Nadine Gordimer ya Naguib Mahfouz nadono sakka ni ooki na keii wo haratsu teimashita.

rows.question: Yasumin gari no sakuhin ni taisuru dokusha ya hihyouka niyoru hannou hadoudeshitaka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali no sakuhin ha, kanjou no fukasa, seikaku no shinsei sei, afurika no fuukei no kyouryoku na byousha notameni, dokusha to hihyouka no ryouhou ni omoni ukeire rareteimashita.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali no shippitsu purosesu mataha houhouron ni kansu ru shousai wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali no shippitsu purosesu ni kansu ru gutaiteki na shousai ha akiraka nisareteimasenga, kanojo no sakuhin ha, kanojo ga egai ta bunka, fuukei, ningen no keiken ni fukai botsunyuu kan wo shisashi teimasu.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali ha kanojo no bungaku de ejiputo no ruutsu wodonoyouni shiyoushi mashitaka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali hashibashiba, kanojo no ejiputo no bunkatekihaikei wo renzu toshite riyou shi, kanojo no afurika no monogatari wo mite meikaku nishi, kanojo no monogatari ni fukami to shin ity sei no sou wo tsuika shimashita.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali ha, kanojo no sakuhin de hokano chosha ya irasutoreetaa to kyouryoku shitakotogaarimasuka?
rows.answer: Daibubun ha dokuritsu shita chosha deshitaga, Yasmin Ghali ha tokiori yuumei na irasutoreetaa to kyouryoku shi, kanojo no monogatari no shikakuteki na miryoku to bunkateki kyoumei wo kyouka shimashita.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali no afurika no janru no shigoto ha, kanojo no shippitsu kyaria wodonoyouni shinka sasemashitaka?
rows.answer: Kanojo no kyaria no naka de, yasumin gari no shigoto ha, sono fukuzatsusa to nyuansu wo fukame, afurika no fuukei to kanojo ga kai ta hitobito no seijuku shita rikai wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Yasmin Ghali ha bungaku no sekai, tokuni afurika no janru nidonoyouna isan wo nokoshi mashitaka?
rows.answer: Yasmin Ghali ha, afurika no bungaku no eikyouryoku noaru jinbutsu, kanojo no dousatsu ni michi ta monogatari, soshite afurika no tayousei to fukasa no fukai tankyuu wo teikyou suru kyouryoku na tokuchou toshite kioku sareteimasu.

rows.question: 1955 nen 6 gatsu 7 nichi ni sanfuranshisuko de umare ta chosha no furuneemu wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: 1955 nen 6 gatsu 7 nichi ni beikoku sanfuranshisuko de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha, tomu meison miraa desu.

rows.question: Sanfuranshisuko de umare ta chosha dearu tomu meison miraa ha, dono janru desuka?
rows.answer: Sanfuranshisuko de umare ta chosha dearu tomu meison miraa ha, omoni gunji shi no janru wo senmon toshiteimasu.

rows.question: Gun no rekishi sakka dearu tomu meison miraa ga sanfuranshisuko ni motsu teitayouna ikusei nitsuite setsumeishi teitadakemasuka?
rows.answer: Gunji rekishi no sakka dearu tomu meison miraa ha, yuniiku na shokugyou no kazoku ni umare mashita. kano chichioya dearu meison ha boueki de ishiku deari, hahaoya ha nougyou gijutsusha deshita. tayou na bunya nisarasarete, miraa ha kano shippitsu ni han'ei sareta meikaku na sekaikan wo kaihatsu shimashita.

rows.question: Chosha no tomu meison miraa ga gun no rekishi niokeru kano shigoto notameni uke ta juuyouna shou wo omoidasu kotogadekimasuka?
rows.answer: Tomu meison miraa ha, kano kaka reta sakuhin wo tsuuji te gunji shi heno nami hazure ta kouken ni taishi te meiyo aru rekishiteki gunji bungakushou wo jushou shimashita.

rows.question: Gun no rekishi no naka de kano bungakuteki na kyaria wo kyouka shita tomu meison miraa no kakkiteki na shigoto ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Tomu meison miraa no kakkiteki na sakuhin ha, (pasuchendeeru: higeki no kaibougaku) toiu taitoru no hon deshita. kono sakuhin ha, zenrei nonai houhou de sensou no higeki wo kapuseru kashi, bungakuteki na bunya de takai shousan to habahiroi ninshiki wo kakutoku shimashita.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa ha, kano kyaria wo tsuuji te kano janru no ikkansei wo iji dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Hai, tomu meison miraa ha kano kyaria wo tsuuji te gunji shi no janru de ikkan shite kai tekimashita.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa no shippitsu sutairu no tokuchou ha, gunji shi no janru de kare wo kiwa tata seteirukotoni genkyuu shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Gunji shi no janru niokeru tomu meison miraa no shippitsu sutairu ha, sono saishin no kenkyuu, senmei na setsumei, oyobi kojin to shakai ni taisuru sensou no eikyou ni kansu ru yuniiku na shiten de shira reteimasu.

rows.question: Chosha no tomu meison miraa niyoru hokano chuumoku subeki sakuhin no risuto wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: (Passchendaele: The Anatomy of a Gragedy) toha betsuni, Tom Mason Miller ha dokusha wo miryou shita ooku no hon wo kai teimasu. koreraniha, (vikusubaagu no houi: chi mamireno sutandoofu), (middouei no tatakai: taaningupointo), (opereeshonmaakettogaaden: daitan na shippai) ga fukuma remasu.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa no kouken niyori, gunji shi no janru hadonoyouni shinka shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Kano yuniiku na apuroochi to hageshii kenkyuu niyori, tomu meison miraa hasono nochi, kono janru no shinka ni purasu no eikyou wo atae ta gunji shi ni muke te, yori kouhan de hijouni shousai na, kojintekina apuroochi wo dounyuu shimashita.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa no kazoku no haikei ha, meison toshiteno chichioya to nougyou gijutsusha toshiteno hahaoya toshite kano shippitsu ni eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Machigai nakuhai. tomu meison miraa no ryoushin no yuniiku na shokugyou ha, kano sekaikan wo hiroge, kano gunji shi no chosaku nishibashiba han'ei sareru jinsei noarayuru ayumi to karera ga chokumen surukamoshirenai tousou karano hitobito no reigaiteki na rikai wo kare ni atae mashita.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa no gunji rekishi no hon ni taisuru juuyouna hannou ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Tomu meison miraa no hon ha hihyouka ni atatakaku uketora remashita. karera ha, korerano rekishi no ningen no youso wo shiteki shinagara, sensou to gunji senryaku no fukuzatsusa wo hori sage ru kano nouryoku wo shousan shimasu.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa no seika dearu sanfuranshisuko ha, kano chosaku nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae masuka?
rows.answer: Toshi toshiteno sanfuranshisuko ha, kano gunji shi no naiyou ni chokusetsueikyou wo atae naikamoshiremasenga, toshi no bunkateki tayousei to yutaka na rekishitekihaikei ha, machigai naku rekishi to ningen no monogatari ni taisuru tomu meison miraa no kanshin wo sodate mashita.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa ga sakusei shita (middouei no tatakai: taaningupointo) no teema to naiyou wodonoyouni setsumeishi masuka?
rows.answer: Tomu meison miraa niyoru (middouei no tatakai: taaningupointo) ha, dainijisekaitaisen no mottomo juuyouna kaigun sentou no 1 tsuni fukaku moguri kon deimasu. chosha ha, gunji senryaku no giron to kyouryoku na ningen no monogatari no baransu wo sensai ni baransu sasemasu.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa no kyouiku to kankyou ha, gunji shi no janru heno kenshin nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Kano kokyou dearu sanfuranshisuko no yutaka na rekishi to, ryoushin wo kaishi tasamazamana senmonbunya heno roshutsu ha, tomu meison miraa no gunji rekishi ni taisuru konomi de juuyouna yakuwari wo hata shimashita. kano ikusei ha, osoraku kare gayori fukaku, yori kyoukan tekina houhou de rekishiteki genjitsu wo rikai shi, setsumeisu rukotowo tsuyoi ta.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa no (vikusubaagu no houi: chi mamireno sutandoofu) no kantan na setsumei wo teikyou dekimasuka?
rows.answer: (vikusubaagu no houi) tomu meison miraa niyoru (chi mamireno sutandoofu) ha, amerika naisen naka 40 nichi ijou tsuzui ta osoroshii houi wo kabaa shiteimasu. kono hon ha, vikusubaagu deno senryaku, tousou, kyuukyoku no koufuku ni kansu ru houkatsuteki na shousai de mita sareta ribettoakaunto wo teikyou shiteimasu.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa ga omoni gunji shi no janru ni kaku youni unagashi tanohanazedesuka?
rows.answer: Tomu meison miraa no janru no sentaku no haigo niaru gutaiteki na insupireeshon ha, kare niyotteshika shira reteimasenga, kano kokyou no sanfuranshisuko no fukai rekishi totomoni, tayou na bunkateki oyobi shokugyou kankyou deno kano ikusei ga gunji shi heno keikou ni eikyou wo atae takamoshirenaito suisoku surukotogadekimasu.

rows.question: Dokusha ga tanoshimi nidekiru tomu meison miraa niyoru kongo no purojiekuto ya kongo no hon haarimasuka?
rows.answer: Tomu meison miraa no gunji shi heno ikkan shita kouken wo kangae ruto, dokusha ha kongo suunenkan deyori dousatsu ni ton da sakuhin ga shuppan sarerukotowo yosou surukotogadekimasu. tadashi, kono jitende tokutei no taitoru ha happyou sareteimasen.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa ha, kano gunji shi no hon deno sutooriiteringu to rekishiteki seikaku sano baransu wodonoyouni baransu sasemasuka?
rows.answer: Tomu meison miraa ha, kano saishin no kenkyuu de shira reteori, rekishiteki na seikaku sawo kakuho shiteimasu. doujini, kareha monogatari no tekunikku wo shiyoushi te rekishi wo ikiiki tosase, kyouiku wo ijishi nagara kano hon wo tanoshii yomimono nishimasu.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa no gunji rekishi no hon ha, hokano katachi no media ni tekiou shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Watashi no shiru kagiri, tomu meison miraa no gunji rekishi no hon hadoremo, eiga, terebi, gekijou ni tekiou sareteimasen. sorenimokakawarazu, kano sakuhin no gekiteki na monogatato yutaka na shousai ha, tekiou ni tekishi teimasu.

rows.question: Tomu meison miraa ha, gunji rekishi bungaku no bunya dedonoyouna eizokuteki na eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Tomu meison miraa ha, gunji rekishi bungaku ni kie nai maaku wo nokoshi mashita. kano yuniiku na shiten, honmono no sutooriiteringu, oyobi saibu heno chuui ha, kano nakama to kongo no chosha no ryouhou ni eikyou wo atae, janru no han'i wo kakudai shimashita.

rows.question: 1969 nen 8 gatsu 1 nichi ni betonamu no hanoi de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Chosha ha, kano shusseichi to shusshou nen wo han'ei shita dentouteki na betonamu no meimei jouyaku wo shiyoushi te, baongien toshite senrei wo uke mashita.

rows.question: Chosha no bao nguyen hadono janru ni purimarii ni kakikomi masuka?
rows.answer: Bao Nguyen ha, omoni seiyou no janru ni bungaku wo sakusei shimasu.

rows.question: Bao Nguyen no ryoushin no shokugyou ni kansu ru jouhou wo kyouyuu dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Bao Nguyen ha, koukuu kanseikan to ekonomisuto no kodomo deshita. kano chichioya ha, hahaoya ga keizai riron to gensoku no kenkyuu ni kanyo shiteiru kan, koukuu koutsuu no kanri wo tetsudai mashita.

rows.question: Chosha no Bao Nguyen ga kano kyaria no naka de katsu ta shou ni genkyuu shiteitadakemasuka?
rows.answer: Seiyoujin no bungaku ni taisuru meiyo aru (goorudensupaa shou) ha, baongien gakono janru heno boudai na kouken notameni kakutoku shita kencho na ninshiki no 1 tsudesu.

rows.question: Seiyou no janru heno kenshin wo han'ei shita chosha no bao nuguen niyotte kaka reta hon no rei wo age teitadakemasuka?
rows.answer: (The Sundowners: A Sacketts Tale, # 17) to (Cheness) ha, Bao Nguyen ga kano monogatari no naka de seiyou no janru no honshitsu wo migoto ni torae ta houhou wo ichijirushiku han'ei shiteiruikutsukano sakuhin desu.

rows.question: Kano shippitsu ni taisuru Bao Nguyen no kodomojidai no eikyou ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Sate, betonamu no hanoi de sodachi, bao nuguen no shippitsu ni ooki na eikyou wo atae mashita. kano seiyou no monogatari deha, kareha shibashiba betonamu no haikei karano youso wo toriire, kano monogatari ni yuniiku na ibunka no jigen wo atae masu.

rows.question: Bao Nguyen no hon ga Golden Spur shou wo jushou shitamonohadoredesuka?
rows.answer: Bao Nguyen no shousetsu (Cheness) ha, seiyou no janru ni taisuru shigekiteki na sutooriiteringu to kakushinteki na teiku de Golden Spur Award de mitome rareteimasu.

rows.question: Bao Nguyen no seiyou shousetsu de mottomo ippanteki na teema ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Bao Nguyen no sakuhin wo koe te, furonteia no seigi, tanken, bunkateki shoutotsu, dentouteki na seiyou no hi es no saiteigi no teema wo koe te, kano ajia no ruutsu tokono janru ni kansu ru yuniiku na shiten wo han'ei shite, shibashiba saihatsu shimasu.

rows.question: Bao Nguyen no shippitsu sutairu nitsuite kuwashiku oshie tekudasai.
rows.answer: Bao Nguyen ha, kano betonamu no isan no gengo, bunkateki nyuansu, tetsugakuteki shiten to seiyou no janru no kanshuu woumaku kumiawase ta yuniiku na shippitsu sutairu wo tenji shiteimasu.

rows.question: Bao Nguyen no shoki no chosaku kara seiyou no janru denoyori seijuku shita sakuhin heno ikou nitsuite setsumei dekimasuka?
rows.answer: Shoki no sakuhin de, bao nuguen ha dentouteki na seiyou no janru no teema ni shitagai mashitaga, kano sukiru wo migaku nitsurete, kareha jikken wo hajime, betonamu no bunka to geijutsu no youso wo monogatari ni yuugou sase, janru no paradaimushifuto wo hikioko shimashita.

rows.question: Bao Nguyen ha hi nishigawa no janru no hon wo shippitsu shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Omoni, Bao Nguyen ha kano nitchi ni chuujitsu deari, seiyou no janru heno shousan wo shimeshi teimasu. kare ga hi nishigawa no janru no hon wo shippitsu shitakotowo shimesu juuyouna itsudatsu haarimasendeshita.

rows.question: Bao Nguyen no hahaoya no shokugyou ha kano shippitsu nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae masuka?
rows.answer: Ekonomisuto no hahaoya to isshoni sodatsu ta bao nuguen ha, ooku no baai, furonteia keizai no byousha to jidai no kinyuu tousou wo toushi te, keizaigaku no youso wo seiyou no shousetsu ni bimyouni ori maze masu.

rows.question: Betonamu no hanoi deno bao nuguen no ikusei ha, kano seiyoujin no kyarakutaa wodonoyouni katachizukuri ttanodeshouka?
rows.answer: Kano seibu shousetsu niokeru bao nuguen no kyarakutaa ha, danryokusei, komyunitei no kankaku, soshiteshibashiba (furonteia) no gainen ni kansu ru kotonaru shiten nado, hanoi deno kano ikusei ni eikyou sareru tokusei, shinnen, shiten woshibashiba shimeshi masu.

rows.question: Seiyou bungaku no gakusha no saakuru deyoku giron sareru bao nuguen no hon nodorehadoredesuka?
rows.answer: (The Sundowners: A Sacketts Tale, # 17) ha, seiyou bungaku no gakusha no kan de hinpan ni giron sareru topikku desu. soreha, dentouteki na seiyou karayori ibunka mano monogatari heno bao nuguen no buntai tekina henka wo arawashi teirutamedesu.

rows.question: Bao Nguyen ha, hon (Cheness) no haigo niaru kano insupireeshon nitsuite giron shitakotogaarimasuka?

rows.question: 1988 nen 12 gatsu 12 nichi ni joojia shuu tobirishi de umare ta herusujanru no chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?

rows.question: Toukyou no bunka ha nakamura takahashi no chosaku nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae masuka?

rows.answer: Nakamura takahashi no kurikaeshi no teema ha, kojin no aidenteitei, shakaiteki kitai, gisei, ai to soushitsu no kano tankyuu de miru kotogadekimasu.

rows.question: Nakamura takahashi ha, kano hon de kano ikusei wodonoyouni katsuyou shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Kano monogatari no naka de, nakamura takahashi hashibashiba, kikaiteki na shigoto no fukuzatsusa to hana no dezain no utsukushisa wo hori sage, sorezore chichioya to hahaoya no shokugyou kara hikidashi, kano ikusei ni kokoro wo utsu genkyuu wo kuwae masu.

rows.question: Hon (A Fue of Me) deha, nakamura takahashi no shippitsu sutairu no youso wo tokutei dekimasuka?

rows.question: Nakamura takahashi no ryoushin no shokugyou ha kano shippitsu sutairu nidonoyouni eikyou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Ryoushin no shokugyou kara hiki yose rareta nakamura ha, shibashiba kikaikei wo tsuuji te mira reruyouni, kano monogatari no shizen de bimyouna utsukushisa de, kano kyarakutaa ya monogatari ni fukami wo kashi masu.

rows.question: Jiden teki youso ni motozu ita nakamura takahashi no sakuhin haimashitaka?

rows.answer: Nakamura takahashi no (watashi no ichibu) ha, hokano sakuhin yorimo kojintekina aidenteitei no fukuzatsusa wo hori sage, shakaiteki atsuryoku to ai ni bottou shi, kihan no bimyouna hankou no nakani settei saretatoki, jibun no haji wo tansaku shimasu.

rows.answer: Nakamura takahashi no shin'en na monogatari ha, rezubian no janru ni juuyouna randomaaku wo kizami mashita. kano sogai sareta monogatari no shigekiteki na toriatsukai to, fukaku fukuzatsu na teema no tankyuu niyori, kono janru nai no taiwa to chishiki no kakudai ni taisuru tobira ga hiraka remashita.

rows.question: 1952 nen 1 gatsu 9 nichi ni umare ta minami afurika no keeputaun no chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Minami afurika no keeputaun desono nichi ni umare ta chosha ha, chosha no shusseichi to LGBTQ+ no aidenteitei wo han'ei shita seiseisa reta namae dearu reivun maree to yoba reteimasu.

rows.answer: Hai, reivun maree ha minami afurika no keeputaun no bengoshi no chichi to doubutsugakusha no hahaoya ni umare mashita. kono tayou na chiteki haikei ha, karera no ikusei to saishuuteki na kyaria no sentaku ni ookiku eikyou shimashita.

rows.question: Reivun maree ha karera no shigoto de shou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Hai, Raven Marais ha, LGBTQ+ bungaku heno juuyouna kouken wo mitome ru randamu ni seiseisa reta mede aru, meiyo aru LGBTQ+ Icon Award for Literature Award deno nami hazure ta sagyou de mitome rareteimasu.

rows.question: Raven Marais ga kai ta hon to, soreraga eiga no janru todonoyouni itchi surukatoiu namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Tashikani, Raven Marais no hon noikutsukaniha, (Shadows of the Silvercreach) ya (Frames In Time) nadono taitoru ga fukuma reteimasu. korerano hon ha, eiga kanren no teema to baitai ni kansu ru dousatsu ni michi ta shiten wo tankyuu surukotode chuumoku ni atai shi, maree no bungakuteki aidenteitei no in toshite kinoushi masu.

rows.question: Raven Marais no LGBTQ+ aidenteitei ha, eiga janru heno kouken wodonoyouni keisei shimasuka?

(The Silent Artistry) ya (Reel Lives) nadono karera no hon ha, kono yuniiku na tokuchou wo shoukai shiteimasu.

rows.answer: Aisha aru hashimu no hon ha, kokoro karano monogatari, yuufuku na kyarakutaa, soshite dousatsu ni michi ta ai no tankyuu nishibashiba shousan saremasu. hihyouka to dokusha ha, kanjouteki na tabi no fukuzatsusa wo utsukushiku torae ru kanojo no senren sareta monogatari sutairu wo shousan shimasu.

rows.question: 1936 nen 3 gatsu 1 nichi ni beikoku nyuuyooku shi de umare ta chosha no furuneemu ha nande suka?
rows.answer: 1936 nen 3 gatsu 1 nichi ni beikoku nyuuyooku shi de umare ta chosha ha, edowaado patorikku sariban to nazuke raremashita.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no chosaku no omona janru ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban no omona janru ha, airurando no bunka to rekishi ni kansu ru bunken desu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban ga bungaku heno ​ ​ kouken de uketotsu ta shou hadoredesuka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, bungaku heno kouken wo mitome te, kagayakashii aauin bungakushou wo jushou shimashita.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no ryoushin no shokugyou ha nande shitaka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban no chichioya ha houshasen ka i deari, kano hahaoya ha eiyoushi deshita.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban ga kai ta hon ni namae wo tsuke temoraemasuka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban no sakuhin no 2 tsuno chuumoku subeki sakuhin niha, (neru: emerarudo airu no monogatari) to (yoru no chinmoku no naka de, hoshi ha watashitachi no ranpu ninarimasu) ga fukuma remasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no shousetsu (neru: emerarudo airu no monogatari) to (yoru no chinmoku no naka de, hoshi ha watashitachi no ranpu ga airurando no janru no konomi wo han'ei shiteirunodeshouka?
rows.answer: Hai, ryouhou no shousetsu (neru: emerarudoairu no monogatari) to (yoru no chinmoku no naka de, hoshi ha watashitachi no ranpu ninaru) ha, airurando no janru no konomi ni fukuzatsu ni musubi tsuiteori, airurando no fuukei, shinwa, soshitesono hitobito no seishin wo shoukai shiteimasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no ikusei ha kano bungakuteki na kyaria nidonoyouna eikyou wo atae mashitaka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban no ikusei, tokuni ryoushin no shokugyou ni taisuru jounetsu karano eikyou ha, kano saishin no kenkyuu sukiru to, kano sakuhin de akiraka na sutooriiteringu heno baransu notoreta apuroochi wo katazukuru noni yakutachi mashita.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no jushou reki noaru airurando ni kyoten wo oku bungaku ha, kano amerika no ikusei no eikyou wo uke mashitaka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha amerika de umare sodatsu taga, kareha tsuneni airurando no isan ni miryou sareteita. kano amerika no ikusei ha, kare ga kano airurando ni kyoten wo oku bungaku ni mochikon da yuniiku na shiten wo kare ni teikyou shi, kyuu sekai no miryoku to shinsekai no kansei no inpakuto noaru yuugou wo tsukuridashi mashita.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no ryoushin ha, kano hon no toujoujinbutsu wo shigeki shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban no ryoushin ha, kano hon no naka de ooku no kyarakutaa ni eikyou wo atae mashita. tatoeba, (neru: emerarudoairu no monogatari) deha, shujinkou no chichioya ha kenmei na ishi deari, houshasen ka i toshiteno chichioya no shokugyou wo han'ei shiteimasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban hadono hon de aauin bungakushou wo jushou shimashitaka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, kano chosho (In Night's Silence, The Stars Will Will Our Lamps) no meiyo aru aauin bungakushou wo saisho ni kakuho shimashita.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, kano airurando no janru no shouten wo kano hon de kano amerika no haikei todonoyouni musubi tsuke mashitaka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, kano youni, amerika nin ga airurando no ruutsu to isan wotadotteiru kyarakutaa wo toriire rukotode, kano airurando no janru no shouten wo kano amerika no haikei to musubi tsuke mashita.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha kano shousetsu dedonoyouna teema wo tankyuu shiteimasuka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, airurando no haikei ni hanshi te settei sareta kano shousetsu niokeru aidenteitei, isan, busshitsuteki oyobi seishinteki na tairitsu no teema woshibashiba tankyuu shimasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no chosha toshiteno shokugyou ha, ryoushin no shokugyou no eikyou wo uke teimasuka?
rows.answer: Chosha toshiteno edowaado patorikku sariban no shokugyou ha, ryoushin no shokugyou no eikyou wo uke teimasu. karera ha, kano kyarakutaa no hatten to purotto kouzou nioite juuyou dearu kano subarashii bunsekiteki shikou to kano ningen shinrigaku no rikai wo hagukumi mashita.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no hon ha, chichioya no shokugyou ga houshasen ka i toshite mottomo meihaku na eikyou wo uke teirunohadoredesuka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban no chichioya no chichioya no shokugyou ga houshasen ka i toshiteno eikyou ha, kano chosho (neru: emerarudo airu no monogatari) de mottomo meihaku desu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no shousetsu nodono kyarakutaa ga eiyoushi toshiteno hahaoya no shokugyou ni nite imasuka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, kano chosho (In Night's Silence, The Stars Will Will Our Lamps) de hahaoya no shokugyou kara insupireeshon wo hikidashi mashita. sokodeha, juuyouna seikaku ga kanojo no machi no yuumei na eiyoushi deari, choumin no shoku shuukan to tabemono ni taisuru taido ni eikyou wo atae teimasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, kano kiji dearu nyuuyooku shi wo kano shousetsu dedonoyouni egai teimasuka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, airurando wo hanare te amerika no yume wo taiken suru kano kyarakutaa no me wo toushi te nyuuyooku shi woshibashiba egai teori, toshi no nigiyaka na raifusutairu, ta bunka kankyou, sorega teikyou suru uno enerugii wo shimeshi teimasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, kano airurando kei amerika nin no haikei wo han'ei shite kano kyarakutaa wo tankyuu suru kadai ha nande suka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha, bunkateki hinan, douka no tousou, dentouteki na airurando no kachi wo ijishi, kano airurando kei amerika nin no kyarakutaa notameni gendai no amerika bunka ni tekiou surukototono kinchou nadono kadai woshibashiba tankyuu shimasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban hadonokuraino hindo de kano hon wo shuppan shimasuka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban ha tasaku na sakka deari, tsuujou ha 18 ~ 24 ka gatsu gotoni atarashii hon wo shuppan shiteimasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no kano airurando nin no hon de shippitsu sutairu wo kubetsu surumonoha nande suka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban no yuniiku na shippitsu sutairu ha, airurando no fuukei to bunka no sen yakana byousha to, nijuu no bunkateki aidenteitei to iki rutoiu nibunhou wo byousha suru koumyou ni tsukura reta kyarakutaa wo kumiawase teimasu.

rows.question: Edowaado patorikku sariban no hon nodorega kano sakuhin wo hajimete yomi taito omou nin ni teian shimasuka?
rows.answer: Edowaado patorikku sariban no sakuhin wo hajimete shiyousu ru dokusha nitotte, (yoru no chinmoku no naka de, hoshi ga watashitachi no ranpu ninaru) ha subarashii shuppatsuten desu. aauin bungakushou wo jushou shi, airurando kei amerika nin no aidenteitei wo settokuryoku noaru monogatari ni tougou suru kano sukiru no subarashii rei desu.
